records.script: This team proves that Impact isn't just found, it's earned, just like a true treasure. Their outreach and passion ripple far behind the field, creating lasting change where ever they go. They are passing the torch to ensure knowledge and passion continues. With a spirit that echoes they rally their community, turning curiosity into opportunity, and students into leaders. Hey you guys! This teams real treasure isn't gold, it's the impact they leave behind. Congratulations Team 9067, The Goonies.

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team's uncanny might has lifted up their community, marching to FIRST's mission. They've built a hill that houses STEM programs, with tunnels to reach all. The winner of Engineering Inspiration is Team 3792, the Army Ants.
A robot so elegant, glowing in purple haze, each machined component a radioactive blaze, industrial and clean, the sharpest machine — The Industrial Design Award goes to — 2556 Radioactive Roaches!

When the storms hit, this team rose to the occasion, showing that FIRST goes beyond the field into the community. They got to work, helping with hurricane relief in a time of need. At the top when it matters most, the Judges Award recognizes Team 3984, Topper Robotics from Johnson City, Tennessee.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team is building more than robots, they are building and planning for the future. They are all hands on deck, mentoring, teaching, and inspiring the next generation of innovators to sustain their team through their Shop Hand Program, to create a lasting impact. This award goes to Team 5740, the Trojanators.

Y'all better keep an eye on the clock, because this team shows up with an energy you can feel the moment they walk in the door. From the stands to the pits, their solid gold sparkle and shine lifts up everyone around them. Great Scott! The Team Spirit Award goes to the crew from Fort Payne Alabama. Team 7428, Gigawatts!

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: A robot where planetary gears set the tone, this rebellious team engineered to the bone, in one fluid swoop, intake, move and shoot — The Engineering Excellence Award goes to — 2638 Rebel Robotics!

This team truly sparked a culture of GP. Always ready to lend a hand or fan the flames of encouragement, lifting not only their team, but others around them. This years award goes to Team 1912, Team Combustion.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: A hundred and five fuel and ready to run, their creative solution, second to none, their thinking so bright, their scope locked just right — The Creativity Award goes to — 2481 The Roboteers!

Some teams aim high - but this team was built to soar. The quality award is all about craftsmanship and wow did this team deliver! Their robot was clean, organized and built with intention. Their wire management was chef's kiss. No chaos, no loose ends-just some solid fabrication. Give it up to the quality award winner, Team 34, Rockets!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team is truly a model for others. Throughout the whole season they integrated simulations, mathematical models, and human integrity to score 98% of their shots. They're in command, it's 3966, Gryphon Command.

This team is always ready for the next day. Their autonomous is the best in the game, hands off shooting is their play. Engineers is in their name, who are we? Congratulations Team 2783, Engineers of Tomorrow.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: These competitors prove brilliance isn't just seen up close, it shines from afar! Dedicated to inclusion, and hosting STEM camps for all, this team draws inspiration from the past to innovate the future. Bringing a rosy light so bright, gotta wear shades. Congratulations team 538, Renaissance Robotics.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.awardName: Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team flew in from afar like a bird. They created open source, repeatable STEM modules and missions for organizations in eight different languages. In addition to growing and supporting FIRST programs, they invented and 3D printed therapy tools aimed at assisting partially disabled, elderly people. This team will definitely spark your imagination!

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.script: High-caliber industrial design involves a mix of aesthetic design and functionality. Thoughtful construction and material selection, including dry lubricant utilization, contributes to their overall success. This team’s robot stealthily flies on the field in black and green, a sight to be seen.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.script: This team is on the prowl for opportunity. They have turned their community into a pipeline of possibilities with training, documentation, and a shared space for many FLL teams. The results are clear - they’ve truly developed an oasis in their robotics desert.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.script: This team’s head is not in the clouds! With their retrospective spirit and community vision, they are already leaving a mark far beyond their first season. This is only the beginning and the judges can’t wait to see what they will EXPLORE next!

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.script: This team INSPIRED the judges with their STEM DEVELOPMENT programs. They way the team EXPRESSED their motivation to EMPOWER the future was impressive. When you hear their name, REMEMBER, the future of FIRST is looking pretty DEER to us.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team has a culture where every student’s passion has a place. Their results don’t just inspire a team, they move a community. The judges learned that sustainability truly sounds like rolling thunder.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.script: This team has a great TALENT for showing their spirit. Their enthusiasm for FIRST is shown both at FRC and in what they put on for their community. This team has embraced the CHAOS of FIRST in all that they do.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team impressed the judges with their well outlined design process from theory to final product. Continuously iterating their design kept them out of sticky situations and drove them towards sweet success. Utilizing their F.E.I. game analysis process was essential to building a seamlessly operating robot.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.script: This team helps other teams climb the mountain of FRC knowledge with sure footed ease. They proactively helped other teams in their country by translating strategies, manuals, and other resources from multiple social media platforms. This team’s Gracious Professionalism is among the Greatest Of All Time.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: The team’s innovative design left us completely inspired, as they cut the cords to engineer a mechanism that is never wired. Guided by six cameras and custom AI, this machine stays right in its lane & hits targets on the fly. This team successfully integrated an unrestricted, triple-coaxial turret that pulls out all the tricks.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.script: This team’s quality is in a CLASS of its own. They mapped a path with a CAN do attitude, indexing all the shapes along the way. With every detail squared away, their craftsmanship defines a new standard of quality.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Blink and you’ll miss it, but did you see this team making shots while screaming across the field? Look again for that flash of pink firing from anywhere, using built in automation to shoot with accuracy. This robot is a literal rosetta stone, translating the complex mathematics of shooting while in motion into a seamless algorithm that works.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.script: This sunny and bright team has built-in 248 potential paths but always seems to choose the best one - filling the hub with fuel better than all the rest. With automatic targeting, shooting and countermeasures for defense, this team’s automated dump shooter is a RUSH to watch. Don’t stare too long, the scores they post are brighter than the sun!

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Archimedes Division presented by Rockwell Automation, Inc.
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team keeps branding in their sights. They keep their robot, pit, and crew fully aligned with their 25 page spec. This tiny and mighty team AIMS to embrace, educate, and empower.

It is hard to resist the clear impact this team had in their region and state. With an electric approach to outreach, their energy sparks inspiration far beyond their home town and country. This team’s electric energy charges everyone around them to spread the mission of FIRST. Congratulations to Team 6647 - VOLTEC!

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: When this team walks into the room, things tend to get a little loud. They scrapped and rebuilt their robot not once, not twice, but three times – cranking out their final iteration in nine days – all while growing a sister team, cultivating a pipeline of FTC and FRC programs, locking in serious industry support, and even drawing a connection to a certain Kansas City Chiefs alumni, because succession planning is kind of their thing. So go ahead - let it out - because nobody has earned the right to make some noise more than this team: Team 4522, Scream!

Much like William Wallace in the 13th Century, this team came into the lowlands of Arkansas and competed admirably. The combination of this team's custom designed 3D-printed parts, a polar-pathing coding tool, and an immense amount of finite element analysis made this team an obvious selection for the industrial design award. Please put your hands together for Team 4499 - The Highlanders!

This team has shown exceptional professionalism by treating their breakthroughs not as secrets to be guarded but as foundations to be shared. By open-sourcing their C++ code and custom swerve drives, they have transformed their own personal success into a viable public resource, shortening the learning curve for everyone following in their footsteps. They’ve shown us that while most use technology to learn, this team aims to teach. The winner of this year’s Judges Award (Transparent Innovation Award) provided blueprints and didn’t “ghost” the rest of us. Congratulations to Team 8753, Spectre.

This young rookie team quickly stood out with their initiative and independent spirit. As a student-led group, they took full ownership in designing and building their own robot, demonstrating innovation beyond their experience level. Congratulations to Team 11102 - Real Steel!

This year’s recipient defines what it means to bounce back. Faced with the daunting reality of having only three veteran members, these students took charge with stealth, by working on recruiting and ensuring the entire pack can leap their knowledge and skills forward. Congratulations Team 6424 – Stealth Panthers!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team has a stable approach to team growth. Their unbridled enthusiasm for people and prosperity initiatives is unbeatable. When it comes to team sustainability, these competitors gallop ahead of the rest. Congratulations to Team 5472 - The Wyld Stallyns!

This team embodies enthusiasm with Un-bee-lievable chants and teamwork. This year’s recipient doesn’t just compete – they swarm with pride! Congratulations to this year’s recipient of the Team Spirit Award, Team 1209 RoboHornets.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team's robot is made from solid rock with a system of mechanisms that is so well integrated it will turn you purple with envy. They circumvented machining limitations with a clever use of 3D printed parts in addition to designing failure points that make sure if they do break they can be easily replaced. Please ERUPT with applause as we congratulate Team 5454 - Obsidian!

While many focus on their team’s scoring, this team made a selfless decision to voluntarily remove mechanisms and pivot their entire strategy. This tactical shift was not for individual glory, it was to become the ultimate team player within alliances. By prioritizing alliance success over their own, they demonstrated that true winners lift others up! Congratulations team 9073 – Skol Robotics!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team blew away the competition for the creativity award. They created a unique shaking mechanism that prevented balls from getting stuck in their hopper. This squad impressed the judges with this innovative solution. Congratulations Team 16 – Bomb Squad.

This team had a robot far “away” from having a component “break”. This team’s robot had the right tolerances to protect performance and the aesthetics of a powder coat that would put George Washington’s wig to shame. Congratulations to the team who consistently pulsed between collecting and shooting – Team 3937 Breakaway!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team trampled the competition with their robots impressive electrical design. They utilized custom printed circuit boards to streamline wiring and help isolate electrical issues so that they could minimize "black" outs and no one could tell them knight-knight on the field. We would like to congratulate Team 2036 - The Black Knights!

This team’s autonomous mode coordinated effectively, consistently, and efficiently no matter who they were working with. Their autonomous checklist ensured they knew exactly what went wrong, and how to fix it. Whenever their robot starts, you may feel a need to stop and yell, shout, or maybe even …. SCREAM A LITTLE! Congratulations to Team 4766 – Scream Jr.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: In a world where sparks fly, robots clash, and innovation is in the air, one team wore their genius with pride. With a look that felt carefully chaotic and positively scientific, every detail worked together to create an elemental presence. For their electrifying headgear and crystal-clear commitment, the Imagery Award goes to Team 127, Bluetonium!

The impact award was incredibly inspiring to judge and we were blown away by so many teams setting up more safe environments in their communities, away from overwhelming stimulants. This team stood out to us because they were the perfect role models for new members, innovated FIRST programs to skyrocket school attendance in rural areas, and hosted online workshops for teams far and wide. What we were most impressed by was their thoughtfulness to give those in critical care an afternoon of joy, as well as helping young kids find their voice. Join me in congratulating a team that proves that FIRST is about getting kids excited about school, and embodies the motto: more than BUILDING BOTS.

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team has ridden valiantly into the competition. They are known for the outstanding outreach, breaking down barriers for people to enter STEM and supporting the disadvantaged in their community. When it comes to inspiring others this team wins the race.

This team weaves precision into every part of their machine. Their robot is a masterclass in elegant design, efficient mechanisms, and a layout so intentional it feels spun, not built. There were no grey areas when it came to their performance, even when they had to put the team on their back.

This team brought an energy you could feel from across the arena — the kind that only comes from people who live robotics. A team whose spirit, effort, and presence stood out in ways no single award could capture. When it comes to robotics, it’s clear these guys are not your average Joes.

These competitors swung open the doors to learning and leadership, running in person classes for local students and even teaching kids internationally. They have a clear passion for STEM and is already planning how they’ll continue to grow, contribute, and make an impact in the future. This team has truly taken a big swing at making a difference at FIRST and in their community.

This team has taken off their training wheels and accelerated into the competition. After being thrown in the deep end in their first design project, they’re now helping shape robotics culture by mentoring junior teams and building international connections. They’ve passed the driving test and are ready for their green Ps!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team is always on the prowl for new members, presenting at schools and running tech conferences. These Lionesses are really out in the community, advancing female participation in STEM. When it comes to ensuring sustainability of their team into the future and caring for the planet, these kids are cool CATS!

This team has stayed united through every storm, coming together with unstoppable spirit, support, and teamwork. They supported others with electrifying energy, bringing their entire minifigure crew along to make an Impact. They STORMED through the cheering sections, doubled DOWN in the pits to lift their teammates, and rose from UNDER every challenge to support the community.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team climbed to the top while documenting their entire design journey. From early sketches to the final build, they seamlessly blended mechanical and electrical disciplines to dismantle every obstacle in their path. When it comes to elite engineering, these competitors are more than just capable—they are officially KOALAFIED!!

This team demonstrates exemplary Gracious Professionalism in the pits, on the field and in opening up their workshop to support other teams. They have role modelled an internal team structure that RED-bull would be proud of, weaving a web of knowledge and teamwork for others to lean on.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: These competitors were chaos creators, firing up the crowd. Jumping head first into the trench and coming out ready to devour, this team sent fuel raining in all directions. This pink powerhouse proved creativity is something they can not only control, but master.

These fierce competitors built a BOT that refuses to back down, strong under pressure and tough in every clash. Their machine demonstrates outstanding quality with smart engineering, and a powerful defensive system, like a ROCK.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Imagine a robot that stays hyper-aware of everything around it — thanks to a trio of cameras working in perfect harmony. In a game where every second counts and the field never stops moving, their turret rarely misses. This team owns the orange brick road and refuses to slow down.

This robot fuses rapid firing and quick navigation to dominate the autonomous tasks. Using vision-guided targeting and the ability to shoot while moving, it delivers reliable scoring before finishing with an impressive climb. This team’s precision programming IONISES the crowds.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Their lively mascot keeps the entire field entertained, making them truly unforgettable. They feature adorable details in the robot, standout in the field brightly, and are recognized by everyone far and wide. They are pack animals that succeed through unity and teamwork.

By charting a course through the high seas of innovation, this crew makes the tide of STEM rise for everyone, navigating far beyond their shores to reach over 1.3 million people worldwide. Their reach goes deep below the surface, advocating in the halls of government to ensure no student is left adrift, while simultaneously delivering kits and mentorship to teams in India, Ghana, Gambia, and the Cook Islands. This team has anchored their legacy envisioning FLL competitions for the visually impaired across the U.S. and U.K., proving they have the wind in their sails to LAUNCH global STEM empowerment.

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This crew goes above and beyond when it comes to community involvement and outreach. With a strong focus on mentorship and team bonding, this team hosts NASA astrocamps, created a Line up and Wait enhancement for airports, and a designed an assistive brace. You can see them parading in their home state with purple shirts and a positive attitude.

This team’s robot proves great engineering is more than power on display. Clean, clever design and lightweight, flexible parts keep it quick and competition-ready. A unique turret system and custom hood whip this robot into action. With form and function working together like this, one thing is clear to the judges’ eyes… This design is truly the cream of the crop — no small fries.
This team is an example of service in their community. While small, they continue to climb the great heights. They open opportunities to teams and campers alike. They set a high bar for outreach.
This team approached their FIRST competition with high energy. Their industry TIEs help them DEFEND their gameplay. With many colors and high energy they have popped breakers all competition.

This team persisted through all and value one another above all. Bouncing from garage to garage, couch to couch, and building relationships with one sponsors this team is DEAD SET in the judges memory. From cold calls, to grant writing, this team planned for the future and have ROCKETED OFF and ESCAPED the atmosphere!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team has developed long term practices for an inclusive environment for all. From team work to student to student mentoring, they have taught each other the difference between righty-tighty and lefty-loosey. This team has certainly built up STEAM propelling this Krew forward for years to come.

Whether they’re in the pit or on the field, this team always knows how to conduct themselves with professionalism, collaboration, and pure energy. This team has certainly charged up the competition this year, powering through challenges with energy and enthusiasm! This team’s spirt is pure plas-magic.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team really took an independent approach to operating their turrets. While some teams avoid the heat, this team takes the "high" road. One could say they really flipped the script when hanging a bot.

This team is outstanding on and off the field, pre season, on the team, and off the team. Loaning their talents, tools, and skills they put their BEAKS to the ground and get to work. They emphasize anyone can be leader, everyone belongs, and mentoring every student to succeed. Across all their efforts, today they have risen above the rest taking Gracious Professionalism to NEW DEGREES!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team’s creativity is in the small detail details. They can adapt to elevation from sea level to Flagstaff to space. They may have a zombie axle intake, but their robot is anything but dead.

Get ready to feel the squeeze, because this machine is built with a level of zest and structural integrity that impresses! With a robust design and a drivetrain that's nothing short of "sun-kissed" in it's orange-clad perfection, this robot has proven it has the power to succeed on the field.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: With a steady hood set just right, their shots take flight and rack up points all night. Three smart iterations made their turret track true, condensing the bot while the scoreboard grew. And with 96% accuracy stacking the score is like a perfect pair of dice!

This team’s autonomous routine was so consistent and efficient, it looked like every movement was flowing through a perfectly designed circuit. With rapid cycle times and the ability to move and score simultaneously, their robot kept the energy flowing throughout autonomous. Judges agreed this performance was truly electrifying.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team meticulously took the judges through their theme. A two clawed approach showcased their focus on both a mastery of knowledge and accuracy. Their dedication to their presentation was so clear that it took flight for the judges and showcased that this team certainly gives a hoot about robotics.

This team has started, mentored and maintained teams across the FIRST spectrum. Their volunteerism for both STEM and non-STEM events ensures they are generating awareness outside of the STEM community. Graduates have earned both large university scholarships and leveraged their sponsorships into paid Intern positions with local industries. They have effectively woven STEM into the local school district curriculum. This team has prioritized sustainability and taken the time to not just document their work down to the atomic level but publish all the information via the web for worldwide access. For this smashing team “Inclusion is not a statement … It’s a practice!

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team is creating systems that help people at all levels deliver STEM education. They have reached local and international communities – and their bot is a great place to start if you don’t have a clue.
This team knows their tech,and knows their tools. Their robot was efficient, fast and smooth. This team proved they can really think, and do it all in black and pink.

Hailing from a small town, this multifaceted team is resourceful to its core. With courage, foresight, and clever decisions, they are a guiding light for their community - finding a way forward and inspiring everyone as they go!
This is a big team ‘stemming’ from a small school. They are building strong connections with each other and their community, and making their ancient philosopher name-sake proud.

Their ability to weather the storms with the resources they had impressed the judges. When they lost access to their shop space, they set up camp in a member’s backyard. This team has proven they can handle the waves of whatever comes next!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team has served as a strong advocate for robotics within their community, establishing firm roots to ensure that the team will endure. In several languages, this team has served as a pillar of hope and resilience for kids in tech.
This team electrified everyone with their spirit and enthusiastically supported other teams and spread the joy of FRC. When it comes to team spirit, they have sparked the interest of many

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: From the first spark in their workshop, this Canadian team built a season defined by structure, strength and precision. By preassigning space in CAD for core components, they kept all options open to the last moments. With spartan precision and a drive that sparks ambition, the Excellence in Engineering Award goes to Team number 9277 Sparkans

This rising team set their goals sky-high and their ambition even higher. By seeking support from neighboring teams and passing that along, they proved that teamwork is the brightest star in the constellation of success. There is only one rating we could give them -

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team showed up with an experimental design on their robot. With a mechanism that allows for a hailstorm of fuel, this team has been a consistent kinetic storm on the field.

This team’s robot didn’t just look like it was built for this year’s competition – it was forged. Their use of durable materials, well-protected components and ease of access stood out. Their machine looked like it was inspired by the gods.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: From simulation with physical models, to testing, to seamless execution in competition, this team did an excellent job of robot control. Like a surfer riding a wave, this team's control system had them gracefully and speedily navigating the field.

This team let their robot do all the talking – and all the scoring. With an unmistakable roar from the crowd, their fuzzy mascot leading the charge, and their dino-mite display of precision – you can’t miss them. Give it up for the powerhouse in green !

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team was constantly a buzz with activity Their yellow stripes and hexagonal shapes were a true standout They have applied great teamwork and the hive mind in everything they do

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.script: O equipe vencedora mostra que o impacto duradouro é construído a partir do olhar detalhado e cuidadoso com a nossa comunidade. Mostra como focar no entendimento dos problemas e oportunidades não se aplica somente ao projeto do robô. A equipe se debruçou em entender os seus arredores, em convencer seus parceiros e buscar recursos em todos os lugares para ampliar ainda mais seu impacto. O time demonstra com excelência todos os CORE VALUES da FIRST e não só os transmite a sociedade, eles a REFORMAM para recebê-los de braços ainda mais abertos. A equipe demostra que HÁ SEMPRE UMA MANEIRA DE FAZER A DIFERENÇA, e isso não é somente uma citação de Power Rangers. Com recursos estruturados, muita criatividade e principalmente: uma paixão por divulgar a ciência e tecnologia a todos.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Quando perceberam que o material didático já não acompanhava as novas necessidades, essa equipe mergulhou fundo para transformar o aprendizado. Com olhar atento para o futuro, acrescentaram conteúdos, reorganizaram ideias e remodelaram o material para tornar o ensino mais atual, dinâmico e eficaz. Com sua inteligência e os muitos braços, eles mostram que inspirar pessoas para a engenharia é um trabalho que alcança todas as direções.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.script: Mesmo fora de seu habitat natural, essa equipe conseguiu apresentar um design limpo e impecável dentro do sítio arqueológico. Provando que o jacaré pode ir para onde quiser.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.script: No espírito de REBUILT, esta equipe mostrou que nunca é tarde para aprender algo novo. Com paciência e dedicação, eles ajudaram outras gerações a cultivarem confiança no mundo digital. Conectando o agro à tecnologia, eles transformaram experiência de vida em uma nova colheita de aprendizado.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.script: Sendo uma equipe nova, eles sabiam que o desafio seria grande — mas também sabiam que não precisavam enfrentá-lo sozinhos. Buscaram apoio de outras equipes e mentores, aprenderam com cada orientação e, passo a passo, conseguiram se estruturar e chegar até a competição. Vindos de escolas diferentes e cidades diferentes, eles mostram que, quando colocamos tudo na mesma caldeira — ideias, talentos e vontade de aprender — a mistura pode dar muito certo

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.script: Quando perceberam que estavam perdendo não apenas integrantes, mas também a própria história da equipe, eles decidiram encarar o desafio de frente. Como verdadeiros exploradores, começaram uma grande escavação: resgataram informações, reconstruíram processos e reorganizaram o que parecia perdido. E como uma nuvem de chuva que chega para renovar a terra do deserto, essa equipe mostra que, mesmo após tempos difíceis, sempre é possível crescer novamente

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Nesta jornada, o impacto de uma equipe não se mede apenas por pontuações, mas pela força de quem se multiplica para garantir o amanhã. Entre o contraste de tons intensos e a solidez de parcerias, eles provam que a sustentabilidade é capaz de regenerar ideias e fortalecer laços com a mesma resiliência de um ser de muitas faces. ​Das areias que pedem ajuda ao sopro de inclusão, eles transformam descarte em aprendizado e silêncio em voz, mostrando que a verdadeira sustentabilidade é aquela que não deixa ninguém para trás.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.script: Essa equipe não apenas caminha nos pits, mas sobrevoa esta arena com a visão aguda de quem sabe onde quer chegar. Com um carisma que ilumina os corredores, este time prova que a robótica ganha vida através da empatia. Elas transformam o orgulho técnico em ação social, acolhendo novos talentos com a mesma paixão com que constroem seus robôs. Preparem as garras e o grito de guerra porque o céu hoje tem dono.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: Como uma semente bem plantada, essa equipe desenvolveu uma base sólida de engenharia. Eles possuem uma abordagem muito profissional no processo de engenharia, buscando a perfeição com inúmeras revisões de desenho, a fim de ter resultados consistentes. E hoje, essa semente como um belo ipê e se torna referência em excelência em engenharia.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.script: Esta equipe viajou de muito longe, mas a distância foi o menor dos seus desafios. Mesmo quando encontraram ventos contrários e resistências pelo caminho, eles escolheram não parar e responderam com parcerias. Das ilhas do norte, ao sul do Brasil, pegaram carona na rosa dos ventos e fizeram parceiros em todos os cantos para disseminar o quão grande e rico é o nosso país. Dessa forma, eles são tão brilhantes quanto a estrela do norte.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Dia e noite, essa equipe brilhou com criatividade. Escavando o campo de jogo, ela desenvolveu uma nova maneira de coletar recursos. Mostrando que o brilho da poeira estelar não é abafada pelas ruínas da arena.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.script: Esse equipe conseguiu se esconder de todos os impactos e problemas. Com qualidade nos ensinou que a excelência exige robustez, muita organização e soluções sólidas. Ela iluminou a arena de roxo e irradiou potência.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Já no início da partida, a equipe chama atenção: seu robô de cores marcantes não para um segundo sequer na arena. Não param também de abastecer seu hub sem descanso, mantendo a pontuação sempre subindo, graças a um controle preditivo que antecipa cada movimento. Porque quando se consegue enxergar o próximo passo, o controle do jogo já começa no futuro.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.script: Nesta temporada de reconstruir o passado, o período autônomo deles foi uma verdadeira relíquia. Rodando múltiplas soluções simultâneas, o robô não hesitou, sempre mirando a vitória. Vindo de uma equipe que é absolutamente fanática por robótica.

records.eventName: Regional Brazil - Festival SESI de Educação
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: A verdadeira identidade não está apenas no destino, mas na jornada. Esta equipe nos guia por trilhas onde cada detalhe revela propósito e imaginação. Pelo poder do "one for all" integraram todos os aspectos demonstrando que a imagem vai além da estética: ela reflete a alma do time.

A equipe vencedora demonstrou um compromisso extraordinário com a expansão da educação em STEM, criando iniciativas que ultrapassam fronteiras, celebram a diversidade, inspiram novos estudantes e fortalecem o ecossistema da FIRST ao redor do mundo. Com programas estruturados, impacto sustentável e liderança exemplar, esta equipe mostrou que robótica não é apenas sobre tecnologia — é sobre pessoas, parcerias, oportunidades e transformação. Eles arrecadaram fundos, direcionaram investimentos, criaram cadeias logísticas, organizaram eventos e assumiram a responsabilidade de desenvolver todo o ecossistema necessário para colocar jovens nos trilhos da FIRST. The subway lines did not bring them to Brazil, but they carried them all the way to the top.

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: No universo da FIRST, existem estruturas que não apenas sustentam, mas servem de alicerce para todos os outros. Esta equipe consolidou sua reputação como referência, não só por aspectos técnicos mas pela implementação de projetos que levam a missão de engenharia através de desafios e hackatons para o coração das comunidades escolares e das favelas. Eles mantêm o futuro da inspiração sob controle.
Com linhas elegantes e um projeto eficiente. Viajaram pelo espaço e aqui vieram parar. Com o poder do sol, acharam o X da questão.

Essa equipe chamou atenção ao transformar o PIT em uma experiência única. Criaram uma solução que integrou elementos da FIRST, imagens e criatividade. Eles integraram um braço robótico ao seu mascote cheio de braços

Como uma equipe nova, a segurança apresentada pelo time demonstrou um forte potencial para enfrentar desafios. Como um ecossistema eles se estruturaram a partir da integração de seus elementos. Reconhecida pelos seus pares, como modelo de cuidado, uma identidade que protege o que há de mais valioso, as pessoas. Na tecnologia, diretamente dos mangues para as estrelas.

Essa equipe transformou sua fraqueza em fortaleza. O que parecia o fim do túnel, tornou-se o alicerce do seu legado. Suas picaretas quase pararam, mas a vontade de minerar o conhecimento foi muito maior.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Com processos robustos e uma visão que não conhece limites, a equipe mostrou que impacto de verdade não tem fronteiras. Com organização sólida e pensamento estratégico, garantiram que o conhecimento continuasse passando de geração em geração. Expandem seu impacto além da arena ao compartilhar aprendizado, fortalecer parcerias e levar ações para a comunidade. Uma equipe que prova que, quando planejamento, propósito e paixão trabalham juntos, o alcance pode ir cada vez mais ao infinito e além!

O verdadeiro poder está na união e na confiança mútua, base para gerar transformações e resultados significativos. Esta equipe se destacou não só por trabalhar com sorriso no rosto, mas também por demonstrarem profundidade nas ações realizadas interna e externamente, se importando genuinamente em fazer bem feito o que se propõem. Vamos comemorar junto com eles, "já que technicamente" estamos todos aqui para isso

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: O calor da partida não os abalou. Com engenharia de excelência resolveram este desafio. E juntos criaram um robô que não derreteu.

Representar o Gracious Professionalism e os Core Values são tarefas complexas dentro do seu time e ainda mais quando vamos além. Este time demonstra a verdadeira força na comunidade que construiu ao seu redor. Com projetos de apoio constante e uma presença acolhedora. Podemos dizer que eles se tornaram uma verdadeira manada internacional que no solo compite, pero deja su huella

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Essa equipe criou um sistema capaz de revolucionar as estratégias do jogo. A criatividade voa lado a lado com esta equipe através do espaço sideral. Com uma ideia vinda de outra galáxia seu sistema de coleta se tornou a marca registrada do seu robô.

Nas florestas da engenharia, surge um espírito guia que observa a arena com uma base inabalável e precisão soberana. Com uma arquitetura robusta que harmoniza a resistência dos materiais à inteligência dos sistemas, este robô entrega funcionalidade absoluta, garantindo que cada detalhe reflita a resiliência e a soberania da Harpia.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Quando os desafios aparecem para essa equipe, eles os perseguem como sua presa. Através de soluções inteligentes, adaptativas e cheias de autonomia, demonstram precisão e agilidade em campo. Eles inovam no controle, abocanhando todos os seus obstáculos

Essa equipe se destacou por garantir que o seu robô chegaria às areas de interesse da arena de forma fácil e otimizada, para qualquer obstáculo a automação está pronta para criar novas rotas. O seu robô sempre está de olho no alvo como vigilantes, a excelência é o único resultado possível quando os Rangers se unem

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Queimaram o antigo para forjar o novo. Mais que uma mudança de visual, uma evolução de propósito. Do solo vermelho ao preto das cinzas, essa equipe renovou sua identidade com ferro e touro

It is easy to SEE how this team is transforming the culture. They’ve driven sustainable growth of FIRST, starting and mentoring many FLL and FTC teams, hosting in-person and virtual workshops reaching tens of thousands of students locally and around the world. They’ve developed meaningful partnerships with many organizations that SHARPEN THE FOCUS on STEM.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: In black and white, this team weaves a strong web of impact, connecting communities through STEM and FIRST advocacy. Through initiatives like their STEM Series and collaboration with other teams, they continue to expand opportunities and inspire growth.
This team believes there is no such thing as too much fuel. Innovators in trouble shooting, problem solvers on the fly, they are true warriors of industrial design.
In bold blue, this team stands out with a unique head-mounted camera and precise control systems. Their innovation is matched by a strong focus on mental health and team support.
No matter who you are you are welcome with this team. Their community and businesses love them. With a capital 'T', they start others out in STEM early to CHANGE the landscape of FIRST.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This COLORFUL TEAM works hard to connect and collaborate with all their members to stay engaged in a family-style atmosphere. Through their many STEAM workshops in the community, they CHOOSE a path to their team's future sustainability by following the LIGHT to their A-HA moment.

This hard-working team is small but mighty. They bring the spirit of robotics and STEM to their Valley like a carnival fair. With a Mall of fun that roars with Imperial enthusiasm. They can be loud and proud.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team went ape on mathematics, outdoing their physics teacher. Their robot is a living "AP FRQ", proving you don't have to be funky to do the math.

This team is one that you'll see soaring, both on the field and in the community. Hosting an engineering expo, their flight plan includes incorporating multiple teams into their events, and interacting with their community through Christmas parades and multi-week summer camps, they are helping other teams and other students to build their nests. Pick a card, any card... Maybe you got their best buddy Gub?

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: When it comes to creative solutions, this team designed a robot that was definitely outside the box. With it's spinning feeder and two extra sides, this team crashed through to lead the way to creativity.

This team geeked out when it came to quality. Giving praise to design members is key to producing quality technical drawings and corrective action plans for manufacturing. This may seem nerdy, but not to the Nerd Herd.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team minimizes their time in the dark. Keeping agile yet lethal, their robot stayed within ears-shot. A delay in their action keeps them in the game.
This team’s autonomy soared above the competition. They executed a flawless double swoop from both sides of the field, striking their target with laser-like precision. A true force on the field.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: The mythical team zipped through the competition, making sure their house, robot and gear set an image that did not muggle the field. Let's not snitch, they sorted to the top!

This year’s recipient of the FIRST impact award is one of those outstanding teams that makes you wonder “Do they ever sleep?” With an amazing group of more than 70 students, this team epitomizes the FIRST Vision with their diversity of activities. Starting and mentoring 8 FLL teams and 2 FTC teams, this team bows to no one, in expanding their efforts to also include meFIRST, LGBTQ+ of FIRST, Invent the Rest and running Girl Scout Robotics badge sessions. Believe me, tying 6-year old Brownies to biomimicry concepts is no small task. As if that isn’t enough, this team develops and runs bootcamps, WRRF seminars, symposiums and other robotics educational activities, making attendees feel as comfortable with STEM, as you would feel snuggling in a warm jacket. Without further ado, hats off to this year’s IMPACT Award winners...Team 1967, the Janksters!

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team makes a point of taking their whole community under their wings. They reach out across languages, libraries and local schools. The can rightly be proud of their red bird's work in inspiring others to take flight into STEM. Congratulations to team 4159, Cardinalbotics!

This machine proved that industrial design is more than looks—it’s elegance in motion. Its cascading intake deploy, smooth double omni-wheel indexer, and field-aware vision system came together in a robot that shot on the move with style, precision, and purpose. Skadi (read Scotty) must be proud to share this name with such an effective design. Congratulations to Team 8...Paly Robotics!

Sometimes a team is like a healthy smoothie, when you put so many good things inside, the outcome is extensive outreach, great team culture and excellent branding. Judges turned green with envy at the team's many aspects, especially their community contributions. Young, but mighty, this Green Machine won the Judge's Award! Congratulations to team 11463...SHC Robotics!

It's not easy to enter an established shire, but clad in shining armor, this team is bravely accepting the challenge. New to the FIRST Round Table, congratulations to our Rookie All Star Team 11243, the Cyber Knights!

These competitors have evolved and re-volved. This team has turned their program around while demonstrating the FIRST mission. When it comes to rebuilding their team for years to come, R-dogg is there to oversee it all. Congratulations to the Rotationaries!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team makes others green with envy. Their robot paints the sky blue and cleans the beaches. When it comes to being sustainable they are eco all the way!!! Congratulations, Team 8016...Eco Robotics!

These bots show up everyday ready for work and fun. Their presence in the sands makes everyone's spirit rise. Named after a delicious treat, this team makes everyone's mood better. Congratulations to the Churrobots!

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: When it comes to their robot's design, these competitors swoop into action. This team's robot shows evidence of his big talons in all aspects of design...from core game components to small details such as wheel covers and custom connectors. When it comes to excellence, this team approaches their engineering process with eagle-eyed precision. Congratulations team 5507...Robotic Eagles!

This team gives their all to provide for others. Their robot was even so gracious that they helped the refs reset the field! We tip our hats to our gracious professionalism winners! Team 1072, Harker Robotics!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team set sail to the arena with a bold vision. While others are stuck on tradition, raiding the field with a design that truly captures our attention, casting a net is their mission. It's time to raise your shields and sound the horns for team 701, the Robovikes!

This team has clawed their way to the top of the competition. Their robot is a sign of resiliency, hunting for fuel on the field with majestic manufacturing. We had 212 reasons to give them this award. (Making a howling noise) Congratulations team 7137, project 212!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team has built custom software systems to push for a competitive edge. When it comes to accurate and responsive real-time programming adjustments, there's Naan better! Just make sure not to spill your lemonade on your red tie! Congratulations to Team 1458, Red Tie Robotics!

This team improved their autonomous quality by using building materials and their robot pushes around large rocks in practice. Named after a powerful earth bender, the robot invaded the field. Congratulations to team 2135 the Presentation Invasion!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: These competitors take flight with a striking presence, surrounding the field with a unified look that’s impossible to miss. From their robot’s thoughtful design to their cohesive branding, this team delivers a complete visual identity. Their coordinated swag, eye-catching gear, and consistent theme show creativity, pride, and attention to every detail. With wisdom, style, and a look that stands out in every corner of the arena, this team proves that great imagery is more than seen—it’s felt. Team 852, ARC Robotics!

In this program, impact is not measured by banners, but by who is welcomed into the Den and who leaves believing they belong. From Cubs taking their first steps into STEM, to Bears leading with purpose, this team rebuilt the pipeline itself through mayhem, turning rookies into leaders and barriers into bridges.” By creating opportunities where they were missing and lifting entire teams alongside them, their legacy echoes far beyond their own community The FIRST Impact Award goes to Team 766 M-A Bears

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team is building more than robots; they’re building a pipeline for the next generation of innovators. Through a strong JV program, active recruitment, and mentorship, they create meaningful opportunities for new students to engage in robotics. Their impact extends beyond their team through summer programs and support for both FTC and FLL teams. By expanding the FIRST mission at every level and strengthening connections with students and sponsors, this team continues to inspire from the ground up. Congratulations Team 971

In a field of complex challenges, this team iterated to success. With their practical designs, they might be giants. For a robot that defines the essence of industrial elegance, this team is the DON of design. Congratulations, Team 840 Aragon Robotics Team.

The team that has shown and embraced the principles of FIRST. We noticed the positive and inviting attributes of this team. We as judges loved seeing them embrace the community and expand the nest. These birds of a feather all flock together. So congratulations to Buchanan Bird Brains, Team 1671!

This brand-new team has resources from their local collective past. From humbled beginnings, this FUSION of a community knows no bounds. This may be a young team, yet it is the scrappiest you have seen. Congratulations team 11296

The Rising All Star award goes to the team that shows the most promising future while proving all of the FIRSt Robotics core values. The team that helped recognize new teams as well as having a new beginning is Team 5700, Sota Cyber Dragons.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Talk about a team that knows its team! Everything they use and make is made from recycled and repurposed materials. From selling Kahob’s at the Ag show to explaining FIRST Robotic Lore values to the next generation! Congratulations, Team 6657 Arbrobotics

The Team Spirit Award goes to a team know for their vibrant presence and unwavering support, both on and off the field. They’re the team with the legendary blue hair, a symbol of their unity and unmistakable style! We’ve seen their members out there, faces joining their fans in the stands, cheering for every round, making everyone feel a part of their stable family. Please join us in congratulating Team 6305, Stable Circuits, with the Team Spirit Award.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: Archaeologists uncovered FOSSILIZED footprints in the rocks. They found COMMON ground by FILTERING out the competition. This team RE-BUILT with a UNI-fied approach and REX-ilent engineering. Congratulations to team 5817, Uni-Rex

If you need something.... POOF, here it is! This team collaborates well on the field and in the pits. They don't hesitate to lend a helping hand and more! Might sound "Cheesy", but if you need help, dial 254

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team proves that sometimes the simplest ideas are the most brilliant. From a self-adjusting funnel to an intake that wiggles its way to free. A-TASK-they-dare-to take on, turning the grey zone into creative ideas and competitive success —Team 973, Greybots.
Match after match this robust RAPTOR scored. When it comes to quality, this team is an APEX predator. These competitors SOARED over the competition. Congratulations to team 1388, Eagle Robotics.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: They went to the LIBRARIES, they hit the books. 100 times faster, every shot had a hook. This STEED knows where it IS, because it knows where ISN’T. Congratulations to Team 3970, Duncan Dynamics!

This team sets the standard before drivers ever touch the controls. Their autonomous performance is a masterclass in integration. With keen eyes that see near and far, they stalk the hub even while on the prowl. When the match begins, these predators are already in control—Team 1323, Madtown Robotics.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team has incorporated all aspects of color into their uniforms and their robot. Their unique use of orange in their name and in their uniforms, and even in their robot makes Team 8793 Pumpkin Bots the winner of the Imagery Award.

Since elementary school they’ve been building their crew, Most of their team came up through the pipeline they grew. They cross oceans, train teachers, leave programs that stand, Spreading FIRST to the corners of the world as planned. Brain, bridge, build, beacon. A smorgasbord of WarriorBorgs have impacted the region!

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team has established themselves as a cornerstone of the local FIRST community. Their impact is widespread, with a combination of FLL mentorship, various camps and workshops, and city STEM advocacy Whether it’s their bot support service or the events that they run, they are truly ELEMENTAL in inspiring thousands in the community.

This team set themselves apart from the competition with excellent packaging and thoughtful aesthetics. Every detail of their robot was IRONed out, from their compliant intake to their clever dye rotor mechanism. When it comes to elegant machine design, this team has CLAWed their way to the top.

This resourceful team didn’t just build a robot; they engineered a culture of constant improvement through retrospectives and collaboration. By optimizing their iteration time and empowering their first-year designers, they proved that a collaborative spirit is the ultimate technical advantage. This group showed the judges that when you make the goals clear and iterate toward them, you'll never MISS, and always eventually find the perfect FIT.

In only their second year, this squad proves that true strength lies in a culture where neurodiversity and unique perspectives are the primary engines of innovation. By fostering a pit environment where every student can lead with their authentic self, they’ve become a model for inclusivity that veteran teams can truly learn from. It’s time to celebrate a team that knows exactly how to SHIFT into a higher gear.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: STRIKING in growth and impact, this team builds more than robots; they build futures. From developing young members to tackling e-waste, they are creating programs and solutions that last well beyond a single season. With every initiative, they continue to sustainably STRIKE GOLD ensuring their impact endures for years to come.

When there’s a need in their community, this team SWIMS through the muddy waters with enthusiasm. Expanding STEM opportunities at their school by creating a makerspace and java classes, you can tell this team is BITING at the water with excitement to share the spirit of FIRST.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: While many teams fully focus on building their robot, this group’s rigorous DFMEAs and checklists proved that they will get better after every mistake. By documenting every failure mode and ensuring their technical wisdom will pass on, they have reached a peak level of SF-iciency. Their professional process proves that great engineering and documentation always work in perfect UNITY.

This team truly knows how to PROVOKE the best in those around them, sparking collaboration wherever they go. As a student-led team, they empower younger members to learn through experience, embracing failure as part of the journey. Whether sharing parts, materials, or knowledge, they consistently lift others up.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: When it comes to creativity, this team didn’t just think outside the box—they redesigned the actuator inside it. With precision so sharp and backlash so minimal, their engineering is as bold and enduring as an ancient empire. They truly nailed a unique mechanical motion that left the judges in awe of their technical ingenuity.

This team engineered excellence into every detail, delivering a robot built for performance and durability. From their latex-roller indexer that just keeps going, to clean, thoughtful wire management, every element reflects precision and care. They didn’t just design for success; they RAIDED every weak point and built it out, creating a machine defined by true quality.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Putting a corrective lens on their camera for better vision, this team is proof that sometimes robots just need glasses. They've dialed in their gains, their calculations are concise and their shot on the move is poetry in motion.

When drivers stepped back and the machines took over, this robot never lost sight of its mission. Locking onto its targets with STELLAR precision, they fueled the scoreboard with consistent shots that never missed their mark. Their ASTRONOMICALLY accurate autonomous routine was written in the stars.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team CHARGED in with an identity that was bold, cohesive, and unmistakably their own. With Rambo leading the way, every detail was locked on target; from design to messaging, with no RAM-ifications left behind. They didn’t just build a brand—they RAMMED it home with personality and precision.

This team has sparked interest in STEAM and FIRST in their community through innovative educational initiatives. With meticulous tracking of documentation and metrics, door-to-door campaigning, book clubs and more, they have kindled opportunities for many around them. The judges admire their herculean efforts with politicians, sponsors, and locals alike, and their musical creativity. We bear a torch for this team!

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team’s story rose above the competition. With their inventive outreach and commitment to helping new FRC teams, they inspire the next generation of STEM professionals. We thank Felix and Phoebe for embodying FIRST core values.

This team’s robot can store up to 50 fuel and then shoot in 3 simultaneous volleys. Their robot has an impact-absorbing intake and vision for field alignment. The judges commend the industrial design of this 3-headed beast!

This team brings focused fun and energy to everywhere they go. Their spirit and enthusiasm create moments that leave a lasting impression on everyone they meet. Wherever they go, they leave behind a path of purple glitter.

This local team just swirled onto the scene, but they are already a force of nature. Not only are they building up their workshop, but they're also building up relationships with other teams. These tornados are a force to be reckoned with.
This team cultivates the mission of FIRST in their community. From mentoring teams to hosting robotics events, they are growing every year. The bonsai may be a small tree, but they have deep roots.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team has seized opportunities to provide infrastructure for FIRST teams across their region. Through cycles of fundraising, pitch presentation, planning, and negotiation, they have brought a sustainable facility to life. Keeping an eye on transportation and accessibility, they assured their practice facility can be used by a diverse cross-section of teams.

An unmistakable wave of welcoming energy has been lighting up the pits during the entire competition, bringing smiles and unstoppable enthusiasm. This team proves that team spirit is not just noise. It is authenticity, connection, and fellowship in action. When it comes to showing pride, positivity, and unwavering team support, one team’s howls can be heard above the rest.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team’s engineering process shows they have a clear vision of the future. Their robot doubles down on functionality, practicality, and direction. When it came to scouting, history was written by the vector.

This team has shown that true strength comes from how you support others, both on and off the field. From hosting FTC events to helping another FRC team get up and running, and even building a dedicated spirit team to lift each other through challenges, they proved collaboration and care drive the future. When faced with a difficult challenge, these nerds created space to listen and grew stronger together—showing that gracious professionalism starts from within.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team’s robot tells a story that every wire has a purpose and every cable has a clean path. The robot features unique precision packaging with multi-directional belting. This unique indexing and turret-based system ensures that this team stands apart - NOMADer the competition.

This team demonstrated exceptional discipline by developing a full-scale prototype to iterate on before committing to their final build. Their robot features an innovative corner mounted turret with an impressive 480-degree of rotation. Nothing is out of reach of their 8 arms.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team truly captures the vision of FIRST. They see technical limitations as an opportunity for learning. They used multiple resources to develop expertise within their team that solves a problem many might see. The judges were overwhelmed by explorations of their 6-camera system, using custom controls and power management boards, to be documented in training for all.
These competitors traversed field obstacles faster than the speed of sound. This robot scored massive amounts of points automatically. They showed autonomous operation was not their kryptonite.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This stellar team wowed us with their visual presentation and their branding. From their clothing to their pit and robot, their branding was consistent and integrated. When it comes to building a brand, they are powered by pink and driven by stars!

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.script: They've got summer camps and published resources a plenty Have got sustainable afterschool programs galore You want workshops? They've got SEVENTY! In Mexico where they mentor, women empowerment at their core Opening their space for all, They work to lower barriers so EVERYONE could be "Part of their world"

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Through videos, new teams, and tools that help bright futures grow, From 3D-printed hope to shared know-how, their inspiration steals the show. From camps to conferences, their outreach sparks every fellow, Spreading STEM like lightning bolts in bold black and yellow.

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.script: A 3D printed wiring chain. A turret accurate enough to shoot on the move. All while staying under the trench. This team decided they don’t need a hopper and proved it on the field. With a five part gearing system running their intake and feeder, our hosts have shown they are deserving of the industrial design award!

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.script: With refurbished laptops, 3D-printed succulents, and engaging video game experiences at the event; this second-year team, rising from FTC to FRC, is ROARING with their creative outreach.

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.script: Robotics is a community of inspiration, which starts off at home. Over the past year, this team achieved a pinnacle of performance and persisted through challenged despite building up from rock bottom. Bringing a whirlwind of technology to the competition, the winner of the Rising All-Star award is Team 3257, Vortechs.

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This incredible team drives full speed ahead—using FIRST's progression of programs to train, inspire, and grow new members year after year. With their mentor-driven, student-powered spirit, they truly SUPPORT one another as they build their generational pipeline - and set a shining example of growth that every team can aspire to follow!

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.script: This team knows what being REBUILT feels like. The secret sauce for this team is mutual respect, enthusiasm for the game, and like a Greek god, protection of the inspiration that fuels innovation. With wings of hope and promise, the Team Spirit Award goes to Team 852- ARC Robotics.

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: When this robot takes the field, it's robust mechanisms are sure to return a high score. Their key roller system efficiently delivers balls into the triple shooter. This team had true CONTROL over the robots design to DEFEAT it's opponents.

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.script: This team changed their culture, and continues to spread the benefits They changed their school's way of thinking from sports first, to STEM first. This unlocked the gates to 20 new team members, 6 FLL teams, and 2 hosted FRC competitions including an upcoming district event.

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: The creativity award goes to this team and their climbing system. With multiple sets of hooks (that can slide!), a gap in their bumpers, and a plan to get to the top bar. This team’s climber is a special ONE. If only there was a level FOUR, but let’s give them a high FIVE, because the winner ends in EIGHT!

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.script: Quality isn’t just what you build—it’s how consistently you deliver, on the field and in your community. With a clearly documented intake plan, a smooth and reliable shooter, and outreach executed with the same disciplined follow-through, they show that excellence is engineered and sustained.

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Bumps in their path? No issue for this team - their control loop still steers them TRUE! Their valiant steed still forges on, a path through the balls, they will HEW! When balls slowed their PID shooter down, they compensated with a control strategy home-BREWED The award for Innovation in Controls goes to...team 670 Homestead Robotics.

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.script: In a competitive field bathed in “Lime Light” what could be more ambitious? This team turned to “George”. “Jenson”, that is, riding in on a custom team designed circuit board. This may be a difficult path, but they share with everyone. This will lead to new capabilities we can barely imagine, but they will make real.

records.eventName: CA District Half Moon Bay Event
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: From their pit to their robot, every detail gallops in perfect harmony — colors, logo, and team spirit charging as one. They blend art and engineering in a way that dazzles the eye and stirs the crowd. So saddle up, because this STEED is far too fine to STABLE

They build more than bots, they build community. They innovate, bringing STEAM to those who are often overlooked. With meticulous documentation, every member is included and inspired. They are a true STEAM Hub. From FLL to FRC, from mentoring to hosting, from classrooms to soup kitchens, from the roads to the sky Their impact keeps growing. Bigger. And better.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team demonstrates that engineering is driven by purpose, mentoring FLL and FTC teams to grow the next generation of innovators. Their outreach extends beyond robotics, supporting fire-impacted communities and developing solutions for medical alarms. For bold, blue innovation that uplifts others, this team shows true Wolverine spirit.
Built like a blockbuster prop, but fully competition-proven. Robustness to prove Form, fit, function, The rarest element in FRC: Team 4 ELEMENT

In navy blue, this team extends its reach far beyond their own program. They bring STEM into their community, mentor emerging teams, and create opportunities that strengthen the future of FIRST. Building more than robots, these golden minds prove that being a little “nerdy” can change everything.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team has made a splash on the environment. They have a comprehensive program through FLL and Vex to roll students onto their FRC team. Focusing on wildlife conservation, they help protect the planet.

In bold orange and black, this team brings the energy of a tiger to Their pride, enthusiasm, and unwavering support embody the meaning of team spirit, roaring in the stands and lifting everyone around them. With every cheer and every roar, this team ignites the arena and elevates the competition.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team’s comprehensive design was approached with discipline and rigor From low fidelity CAD to quickly squeeze out challenges, to the use of JIRA to efficiently prioritize and task Their robot performance was truly unmatched, with an Orange tide sweeping the field

Whether it’s helping other teams or displaying incredible sportsmanship, this team in red sets the standard for Gracious Professionalism. They celebrate FIRST Core Values by making STEM accessible to everyone. This South Bay team is the definition of Empathetic Engineering.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: When things get a little stuck, this team does their signature jiggle. They are powered by a corkscrew to enhance their fuel. They’ve got a grip on creativity.

From design to implementation, this team's robot has stood the rigor of the competition with their clever use of 3D printed parts. Its modular design makes repairs and modifications a breeze that everyone is sure to NERD out over. It's not six, it's not seven, it's 687!!!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team knows three heads are better than one. Their drive team and robot think in perfect unison. When their three heads bark they set the field on fire.

These ferocious competitors foraged for fuel relentlessly. Their high-performance autonomous code allowed them to adapt seamlessly to the needs of their alliance partners. Their roaring courage led to consistently high scores, matching their powerful presence.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team’s branding is consistent, and integrated into all aspects of the team. From having a team branding document and adhering to specific hex codes, these teams take visual presentation seriously. With Sapphire and Spanish Orange colors, you’ll notice this team’s presence from the Sand to the Sea.

This team brings impact to new LEVELS. Whether it's growing access by breaking down paywalls at summer camps, or cultivating inclusion through Unified Robotics, their gameplay is truly phenomenal. With 20% of all youth in their community served by them, over 10% of all FRC teams served by their service team, and more than 300 students served by their CTE classes, the progress they continue to make is unyielding. Throughout all of their growth, they remain focused on their mission: giving every player a chance to press start on their journey in STEM.

In order for kids to soar, they need to have a path to follow. This team has a comprehensive approach to changing the culture in their area, with progression programs starting at kindergarten and progressing all the way through 8th grade. They host and mentor FLL, FTC, and even cohost FRC events and provide discounted livescans, building a NEST out of STEMS for their community. But what impressed the judges most was the effect this outreach had on their own team members- it shows when you take kids under your WING, it only makes you SOAR HIGHER.

records.awardName: District Championship Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team has launched a mission to ensure the future of engineering is as bright and inclusive as possible. By gathering global data on the experiences of women in robotics and turning the pits into a live classroom for young scouts, they have bridged the gap between research and real-world inspiration. Their dedication to opening doors for the next generation proves that building a community is just as vital as building a machine. For showing us all that the journey toward equity is truly the SWEETEST victory, the award goes to ...

A turret printed, large and GRAND, With complex geometry carefully PLANNED, Sandwiched firm in aluminum's EMBRACE, A shooter built with power and GRACE. Tied up neatly, silicon-sealed TIGHT, A ribbon-wrapped machine of MIGHT. The whole package, through and THROUGH— And that claw? It's to DYE for, TOO.

Who shows the true heart of a WARRIOR by sailing through the stormy seas of mentor turnover and lost engineering classes? What they accomplished was a MASTERCLASS in resilience, iterating through multiple robot mechanisms while keeping their spirits high and their focus sharp. This team proved that no obstacle is too great when you have the VIKING strength to row forward.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This team’s results prove that success isn’t LUCK - it’s earned through vision, grit, and organization. With impressive and detailed documentation, including plans, financials, design, code, and much more, they created a playbook others can follow. Their impact already reaches far beyond the competition field through workshops, demonstrations, and community cleanups.
