records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: It’s time to sound the alarm! The dashboard indicates when a change needs to be made. The spark for this team came into the competition like a blaze!

The mavericks of this high-flying team make the fuel seem like wire-guided missiles. Their accuracy in auto would make you think they’re using GPS to pilot the robot. With a high scoring two trench auto run, these Broncos rode into victory.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Despite their young age this team has built a strong team image that is shown across there pit, team members and robot. They made the judges squeak with joy as they describe the history that drives their team brand. Crossing many roads to come and compete this nutty team and their clucking mascot is hard to miss.

This team is out to make some NOISE. You can hear them nearby and around the world. Rustling up support from the Society of Women Engineers, they BEEP, BOP, and CHEER for girls in STEM. They once were silent, now hear them ROAR.

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team travelled far to tell us how they spread engineering to their community. They addressed the unique challenges of their community by making engineering accessible. From Robot in 3 Days to Paper Legos, they are creating exceptional solutions.

This team's robot features a precision-engineered rack and pinion intake, with a conveyor belt feed ensuring smooth fuel acquisition with minimal complexity. Its new drum launcher, enhanced with a high-friction cat-tongue grip, delivers consistent, accurate shots through optimized contact and energy transfer. Sporting an indigo glow, this team has "rippled" their way to the top!
This team knows how to connect in different ways throughout the community. They have pure strength in impacting the next generation. They are true Green titans for both inspiration and retention.
This team quickly learned the value of partnering with other FRC teams and sponsors to build up their team and robot. Their robot, Rainmaker, is on a discount sushi roll.

This rising team didn't just bounce back -- they spun forward with unstoppable momentum. Doubling in membership, they turned last year's late start into this year's early success -- showing up competition-ready with advanced capabilities and serious drive. Hailing from a small town in Ottawa you can't miss these red vests and the cyclone gear.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team prides themselves on the alliances they create. They not only sustain themselves with their pipeline but also sustain other FIRST teams, starting and restarting several in the last year. May the Force be with these Rebels!

If you make a whistle stop at this team's station, you'd be impressed by the cheering and waves of support. The team has grown so well that it decided to split off a junior team, but they've kept the spirit even as they doubled the number of robots supported. They continue to work closely together, collaborating with their younger teammates as they keep the train rolling down the tracks.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: Their NORTH star led this team to a well-designed bot. This team's robust prototyping gave them their HORSEpower. You can't BUCK their amazing turret, their CYCLONIC point scoring proves it.
When disaster struck, many teams answered the call, but one stood out above them all. Both judges and teams called out this team for swarming to their aid.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team has used their collective ideas to design a robot that uses a turret to help fire fuel as fast as the wind blows. Using a constant tension spring to launch their turret, they can shoot in different angles.

These cats are on the prowl for good quality. The judges were particularly impressed with this team's forward thinking design process with predictive failure analysis. This team didn't wait for the problem to appear, they designed to anticipate them. With this approach, there is no doom in this temple.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team uses their imaging to embody the principles of FIRST. Their controller displays their fighting spirit. With their eternal smile, they never worry about losing a part.
They're not prone to pussy-footing around, with an autonomous that can't miss. Watching this team will make you feel like you've been swept up by a TYPHOON.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team's pit was all decked out. The team name and number were up in lights in the pit and on the robot cart. In Red and Black, this team was on FIRE!

Despite being the only FRC team in their area, this group has been successful in growing a robust FIRST pipeline and developing a strong network of community partnerships. The team offers scholarships for their very popular STEM camps. These not only attract a wide range of promising students but also serve as fundraisers to sustain their program. This team supports their community at every level – they successfully approached their school board to establish athletics-level stipends for teachers who are FIRST coaches. Despite disruption of their colony, this team remained resilient and established a new build space which serves several FIRST teams within their community. Sometimes the smallest creatures are the mightiest – the triumphANT ! Congratulations Team 3792, the Army Ants!

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Leaning into their techno-mammalian instincts, they don’t just chase challenges, they stalk and pounce on opportunities landing on breakthroughs. These bionic felines inspire future engineers by delivering sustained and measurable change beyond the robot; through legislative action, support for military families and advocacy for the environment. Congratulations to Team 4256 - Cyborg Cats!

This team is more than mythical. They spun up integration between fuel storage and shooting. This teams robot shares a name with NASA's lunar exploration program. Congratulations to Team 9401 - Midas' Mayhem!

This plucky team uses a variety of sensors and algorithms to let their robot help its operators. Multiple redundancies ensure this robot is firing on every neuron. Simple, intuitive controls help their rookie driver dominate the competition. Congratulations to Team 3931, the Cockadoodle Dominators!

This team is charged up and ready to take a sweet bite out of the competition. They truly live the FIRST values through their camaraderie, community outreach, and infectious enthusiasm. After such a strong debut, every team will be scouting them in the future. Congratulations to Team 11195 - Volt Robotics!

This team’s main goal was to spend the year growing to renewed heights. Their 6 returning members hosted fall training programs, middle schools, & new mentors to grow to 37 active team members. Though they faced many duels along the way, their newfound momentum helps them cheer “all-for-one!” Congratulations to Team 6744 - Mehlville RC!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team gets a sustainability feather in their hat. Raising funds for a building for future seasons, this team will be in the robot building business for years to come. Let's give a cheer "All for one and one for all!" Congratulations to Team 4329, the Lutheran Roboteers!

Every competition needs a team that rules the roost, not only on the scoreboard, but in the stands, pits, and on the field. This team's spirit was the crunchiest, boldest flavor at the event. Congratulations to Team 9428 - the Cashew Chickens!

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team has a well laid out and designed robot and keep things low. They researched past intake and shooter designs and developed a design that was functional and modular. This team and their robot have ACED the test for long distance travel for the competition. Congratulations to Team 5823 - ACE!

When factoring the ways a team can collaborate on and off the field, this team excels. From lending repair kits, to mentoring younger teams, even across oceans, they exemplify good sportsmanship. When every second counts, 10 Factorial shows gracious professionalism. Congratulations to Team 6817 - 10 Factorial!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This pack runs silent, runs clever, and always finds a way through. Why go up when you can go wide? Developing a creative payload expansion and still being able to go through the trench impressed the judges. All the while, driving fear by the howl of the hounds. Congratulations to Team 4500 - RoboHounds!

This team impressed the judges with a creative integration of the collector, conveyor, and multi-shooter. High-quality construction, featuring powder-coated machined parts, 3D-printed components, and a robust industrial drivetrain demonstrates their exceptional craftsmanship. A simple custom 1 button shooter thrusts this team into the “lime-light”. Congratulations to Team 931 - Perpetual Chaos!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Their layered approach to integrating controls and strategy is continuously impressive. With turrets that independently determine the best direction to turn, their robot is always lined up for a shot. This team has considered every part of their control process, even varying their intake and swerve drive speed to prevent fuel from rocking out of the robot. Congratulations to Team 1706 - the Ratchet Rockers!

Like an animal that never stops eating, this robot runs one rule: take every point in sight. Their greedy algorithm hunted the field and left nothing on the table. Please join us in celebrating the Autonomous Award winner.. Congratulations to Team 6391 - Ursuline Bearbotics!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team flew into the competition with a fervor stirring the nest around them. Radiating a striking resilience, their sunny appearance ensures they are seen from a distance. This team created a buzz by fully aligning their visual identity with their machinery. Congratulations to team 8069 - The Super Hornets!

This team works tirelessly to ensure a positive impact in their community and surrounding area. They are dedicated to improving the lives of not only their team members, but also those who participate in their summer camps, users of their adaptive devices, awardees of their grants for FLL and FTC teams, or the information and wisdom gleaned from more than a quarter century in FIRST, and freely shared with the larger FIRST and STEAM communities. This team is not hampered by their small size, or their rural location, actively seeking ways to both broaden their reach, and strengthen the programs they have created. They have learned that eaningful impact takes time, and a legacy is measured not in banners, but in barriers removed, engineers launched, and communities empowered. They don’t build robots for a season; but opportunities for lifetimes. Qualifying for the Houston Championship…

The very culture of this team produces not only dedicated, hardworking team members, but also future leaders in STEM. Through their steadfast contributions to robotics, this team has made STEM more accessible to their community and globally. Their operating monitor system keeps programs the in FIRST sustainable over time, strengthening the pipeline from FLL to FRC. Forming an international coalition to make STEM resources more available, their tutorials have been adopted by FIRST. Engineering tutorials, educational videos, and STEM-related books are made available to under-resourced schools, in their own back yard and across the globe. Strong in supporting women in STEM, scouts, and developing problem-solving skills in young children for 22 years. Like the cougar, this team’s leadership and powerful actions continue to make a lasting impact. Qualifying for the Houston Championship…

records.awardName: District Championship Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team not only understands FIRST values, but also shares them with their community. This year, they have taken their efforts on tour internationally. They're willingness to T.E.S.T new ideas such as 3D-3 toys and incorporating a robotics diploma have already inspired the judges.

records.awardName: District Championship Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team celebrates STEAM by attending community festivals. They have a lot to look forward to this summer between their science academy and YMCA robotics workshops. They are a “RoboForce” of community inspiration.

Well rounded teams simply impress on the field of play and beyond. In a season known for fighting fires, this team brought a fire hose to the competition. April showers bring out the best daisy flowers.

The time is always right for this team to defend. They took a beating in their preseason, to deliver a knockout at the district championship. And just like a Timex, “they take a licking and keep on ticking”.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This team has a holistic view of what FIRST is all about. Their focus on community and commitment to engaging, hands on learning is in full SWING! They will tee up their fresh prospective on Discovery Green and beyond.

Every team faces challenges early in their journey upwards to success. Some endure the hardships of the climb towards the top. This team scaled their mountain and now has a view from the ridge of the path ahead.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team wow’ed the judges by changing their outreach strategy, quadrupling their impact in the community, and engaging new sponsors as partners, not just a source of revenue. Preventing thousands of pounds of food from going to the landfill and using it to feed their community demonstrates the kind of innovative thinking that keeps teams in business. With a strong pipeline in place, we look forward to seeing this team’s growth for years to come.
This team dug deep into the past and brought a lot of spirit to the competition, unleashing a Tempest of stories from years past. The team spirit award goes to Dr. Carp & Team 2016.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: The judges love this team’s significant documentation and ability to explain the design process in a way that is easily understood. Clean powder coated and color coordinated lines show off a machine that is easily maintained and performing at its best. Despite their name this team graciously looks to lift others to succeed. Oh my Lordy…….

When a team was stuck in the boonies, they got word from a news boy. They put on a flat cap and sent a bus to the rescue. The Gracious Professionalism Award for saving a flock of owls goes to team 708.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team collects detailed scouting of opponents and puts it in their nest. They pick the right play and make sure that the early bird steals the fuel.
This teams robot resembles and elegant warrior. They don’t need a holy grail to make the competition dizzy. Everyone watch out, here comes “Izzy”.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: With a high-speed high-scoring competition, consistent accurate control gave this team an edge. Proving two heads are better than one, they manage to keep both coordinated on a swivel. It’s clear that at the end of a new season, their labors are finished.
This team’s robot can really do things. Their performance on the field shines bright like a gem. With the glimmer of a ruby, these sisters autonomously rock the competition!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team continues to grow and explore the Mesozoic era with renewed enthusiasm, uncovering the past to build the future. Welcome to BETA-rassic park.

This team has dedicated themselves to dismantling societal, cultural, and institutional barriers that once kept brilliant minds on the sidelines. They have cultivated a true “Circle of Impact,” building a sustainable ecosystem that bridges the gap between schools, industry, and government. Their commitment to the future is absolute, maintaining a complete 12-year pipeline that mentors the next generation of innovators at every single grade level. By engaging directly with national leaders, they successfully advocated for revolutionary changes in university admissions—shifting the focus from mere test scores to the real-world passion and dedication found in STEM programs.. But their work doesn't stop at the classroom door. From securing vital funding for female, indigenous, and disabled students to developing a robot that reduces the labor of local farmers, this team is a powerhouse of real-world change. They aren't just advocating for the environment; they are on the front lines—planting trees, organizing cleanups, infusing technology in their TECH farm and deploying trash-collection robots to show the public how technology can protect our planet. Talk about a 'loco-motive' for change, this team is literally riding the rails to ensure that even the most remote students are inspired and empowered to lead. For cultivating a more equitable future and sowing the seeds of change across their entire country and beyond, we are proud to present the Impact Award… Congratulations, Team number 6998, Unipards

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team is inspiring future engineers in their school, under-served communities, and around the globe. They believe in opening spaces for girls in STEM from their team leadership to their young-est protégé. Their continuing efforts to advance the FIRST mission by making custom toys to teach physics principles to local children and developing a Driver's Playbook and Programming Guide for FIRST Global Challenge indicate a bright future beyond their Quinceaniera. Congratulations Team 4400!
This team pushed through the design process... Their robot demonstrated how they see in creating a robot that is more than pretty lights... This team could design a robot standing on one leg...

This team’s energy ignites both the field and the community around them. Through innovative design, mentoring FTC teams, championing women in STEM, and lifting up others in the pits with tools and support, they fuel far more than their own success. Like a spark hidden in citrus, this team and their Robot Lemonine prove that Combustion isn’t just a name, it’s who they are.

This team’s ambitious robot tackled bold ideas with persistence and trial and error, steadily navigating the ups and downs of a first-season learning curve. Their lively mascot—sleek, spirited, and inspired by a Gulf marine favorite—became a crowd favorite and a standout star in a local parade. They brought hands-on STEM excitement to children of all ages, truly embodying the rookie spirit of inspiration. Congratulations to Team 10961, HyperWave.

Though still in their youth, this team has brewed a potent blend of strength, much like tea steeping to reach its full flavor. Their outreach and core values fly higher than anything we would expect from these crowned fledglings. With initiatives like advocacy, a STEM HERizon website, and a Rising transitional FLL program, this team is riding a blue flame to the future. Congratulations to Team 10661, Blue Phoenix.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team strikes like lightning, delivering powerful impact. They help every watt in their community and spark real change. For their outstanding achievement and the thunderous difference they continue to make. Congratulations Team 4107, Storm.

This team rides the wave of innovation and resilience, igniting passion in every match they play. Like a spreading fire, they bring energy, connection, and a spirit that unites everyone around them. This competitor shares their spark with every team by giving out buoy bags filled with swag and stress balls, lifting others up and strengthening our FRC community.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: These builders entered the competition with the confident stride of true engineering mas-ters. Their robot showcases a seamless integration of mechanisms—every subsystem working together in perfect harmony to create a machine that moves with intention and strikes with purpose. When it comes to engineering elegance and unified design, none roar louder than the Tiger Bots! Congratulations team 2183!

These flashy competitors help others navigate mazes off the field. They're recognized for spending as much time in other teams pits than their own. One thing is for sure, they always deliver a SUPERCHARGED hit. Congratulations, Team 10101- Critical Hit.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team brought a burst of originality that stood out from the start. Their creative design turned an unconventional idea into a smart, intentional advantage. And their innovative control system proves that when it comes to a solution that’s totally wild, these cats know how to rock and roll. Congratulations team 3039!

This team rocketed its way to the top of the judge's list with assembly processes that include testing, iteration, and continuous improvement. This team fused robustness and durability into a quality competitive robot.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team dug in with an innovative control system that delivered smooth, precise purple performance from a light yet solid, radio-active machine. Like a monster truck gripping the terrain, their bot, Grave Digger, handled every challenge with power and consistency.

This team stormed onto the field, blowing away the competition with its dynamic shooting and reliable autonomous paths, leaving high scores in their wake. True to it's name, this robot has the strength of a rolling Cat 5 hurricane.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team theme embodies the FIRST Core Values. Their signature color shines from their uniforms to their Pit to their robot. These girls begin with joy and end with Sparkle wherever they go. Congratulations team 7094 Alpha Omega.

Este equipo se caracteriza por tener sus líneas estratégicas muy bien definidas y saber apilar uno a uno cada proyecto formando una columna estructural fuerte y su impacto ha seguido creciendo año con año. Este equipo como en el Mago de Oz, siguen el camino amarillo por lo que este premio definitivamente es “for her, for all, for us and for them”.

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Este equipo busca ser simple y eficiente para dejar huella. Impactan a su comunidad externa e interna, dan continuidad a todos sus proyectos, y desarrollan a sus integrantes. Nos demuestran que un equipo joven puede ser la chispa que guía en la oscuridad.

Este equipo presenta un diseño versátil y ligero, novedoso para la recolección de pelotas. Reconocen el legado de las personas que ya no están y que contribuyeron al engrandecimiento del equipo. Fiero en su imagen, con mucha garra y consistencia. “I want to hear you roar!”

Este es un equipo que consistentemente aparece entre los primeros lugares de la mayoría de las categorías, siempre “topeteando” con fuerza metálica. No solo construyen robots, sino con resiliencia trabajan el liderazgo y trabajo en equipo, con impacto social en la divulgación científica.

Por ser un equipo con un robot de diseño elegante y funcional, han demostrado una eficiencia que muchos veteranos tardan años en alcanzar, compitiendo al tú por tú en cada match. Pero lo que ocurre fuera de la cancha es igual de impresionante: han forjado un vínculo inquebrantable con su entorno, logrando un apoyo comunitario tan fuerte que su financiamiento es el reflejo directo del cariño y la confianza de su gente. Este equipo ha encendido una chispa que promete convertirse en un incendio de innovación y liderazgo en su región. Han demostrado que cuando la comunidad te respalda, no hay meta inalcanzable ni desafío que pueda detenerlos. Porque vienen de un lugar donde el termómetro no miente y la pasión se siente en cada grado de temperatura...

Este equipo tiene una filosofía de diseño refrescante: en un campo lleno de gigantes, ellos apostaron por un robot pequeño y sencillo, pero con una eficiencia que desafía las expectativas. Sin necesidad de sensores complejos o programación densa, este equipo demostró que la ingeniería mecánica pura es infalible, logrando colgarse de la torre con una consistencia que muchos equipos avanzados envidiarían. Han demostrado que el éxito no depende de la complejidad, sino del ingenio de quienes se atreven a reinventarse. Su energía es vibrante y su trabajo es el fruto de un esfuerzo maduro y constante. Desde la tierra de las mejores fresas del mundo ...

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Este equipo muestra procesos de sustentabilidad robustos tanto al reclutar nueva sangre de manera eficiente, cuidando siempre sus finanzas como guerreros ancestrales así como los medios de los cuales los obtienen. No solo muestran respeto por el medio ambiente, sino que contribuyen a su cuidado cada día. Por una sustentabilidad longeva ...

Este equipo llega a la arena con un espíritu tan vibrante que es imposible no notarlo. Sus colores, su energía y su presencia hacen que las gradas se llenen de vida cada vez que aparecen. Ellos encuentran inspiración en las raíces de nuestra historia y demuestra que la tradición también puede convivir con la tecnología y la robótica del futuro. Destacan orgullosamente con un color que es tan mexicano como el personaje de su logo.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: Este equipo demuestra un enfoque profesional en el proceso de diseño y una integración sobresaliente de principios de ingeniería. Su robot destaca por su elegancia, eficiencia y por la manera en que su forma y función trabajan juntas para resolver desafíos complejos. A pesar de su corta edad, los jueces quedaron particularmente impresionados por cómo sus integrantes, a través de un proceso disciplinado de diseño e iteración, han logrado transformar ideas sólidas de ingeniería en una máquina robusta y confiable. Vistiendo la piel del cordero, representaron por primera vez a México y Latinoamérica en las canchas de Einstein.

Este equipo demostró en todo momento su apego a los valores de FIRST, pues en su búsqueda por la victoria, se comportan como verdaderos halcones verdes de alas largas, con gran visión, alcance y profesionalismo. Esto los hace ser reconocidos dentro y fuera de la cancha por todos los competidores.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Queremos hacer mención a un equipo que sobresale en las ideas originales que aplican, demostrando que la imaginación, cuando se combina con ingeniería, puede marcar la diferencia en el juego. Indomables en la cancha y con una creatividad cerebral que conllevan a sus alianzas y cubrirse como el cielo de Santa Catarina de “celeste”.

Este equipo presenta una maquinaria bien definida, en constante evolución y que refleja en cada partida la buena calidad de su diseño y el arduo trabajo de programación. A este equipo le gustan los retos y lo retro, su linda robotina “Shelby” se caracteriza por ser versátil, pragmática, perseverante y evolutiva.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Este equipo ha demostrado que la experiencia es la base de la generosidad. Su innovación no se limita a su propia ejecución, sino que busca reducir las barreras de aprendizaje para los equipos que apenas comienzan. El equipo lleva en su identidad la fuerza de sus raíces, recordando siempre que la unión y el conocimiento compartido son la clave. Han desarrollado una herramienta fuera de este planeta que permite un desarrollo más ágil y sencillo, acelerando el camino hacia el éxito para otros. Su presencia en el torneo es inconfundible; dondequiera que mires, su energía se extiende como una fuerza imparable de la naturaleza. Porque cuando la sabiduría ancestral se encuentra con una tecnología galáctica, el resultado es... la mancha verde.

Este equipo es orgullo de nuestra región, con una trayectoria que los ha llevado a ser un referente indiscutible en la escena internacional. En los pits, su máquina destaca por una estética futurista, envuelta en acabados sobrios y profundos que proyectan un carácter dominante y un enfoque absoluto en la victoria. En el campo, su ejecución durante los primeros segundos del match es simplemente magistral. Han desarrollado un sistema tan refinado que parece tener una visión infalible, demostrando que en esta temporada no hay objetivo que se les escape. Su precisión es tal, que nos convencieron de que cualquier elemento en la arena está destinado a ser encontrado y procesado con maestría. Porque cuando la tecnología se diseña para dominar, no hay 'hub' que no pueda ser capturado...

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Este equipo toma lo más pequeño y lo convierte en una gran idea. Los valores de FIRST inspiraron sus colores que se representan en su pit, sus uniformes y su robot. Todos deberíamos adaptarnos y ser como los ajolotes.

Cuando se habla de impacto, el compromiso es tan grande como las necesidades de la comunidad, y la trascendencia que se busca dejar. Es ver reflejados los valores promovidos por FIRST en cada persona que ha sido tocada por las iniciativas realizadas. Para mantener su trascendencia, comparten su conocimiento y experiencia a los futuros steamers. En el camino han encontrado el pozo de agua que permite florecer las rosas en el desierto. Desde el espacio el principito los inspira.

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Lo que hace a este grupo verdaderamente excepcional es su visión a largo plazo. No se conformaron con aprender; eligieron enseñar. Han llevado el STEAM hasta los rincones más lejanos, sembrando curiosidad en niños y niñas que, inspirados por su ejemplo, hoy ya forman parte activa de su equipo. Así crean un ciclo de éxito: el niño que hoy juega con un sensor, mañana se convierte en el ingeniero que lidera el cambio. Porque son la prueba viviente de que el trabajo que inspira es el que se comparte, y porque demuestran que en el corazón de un equipo de robótica late el futuro de toda una comunidad…

El equipo ganador de este premio comprende que un gran robot no solo debe funcionar de manera excepcional y ser fácil de mantener, sino también cautivar a primera vista. Han logrado un equilibrio sobresaliente entre forma, función y estética, cuidando cada detalle con intención y creatividad. Incluso se tomaron el tiempo de hacer que su robot huela bien. Eso es verdadero diseño… Además, son un equipo diverso, con una gran camaradería y una personalidad única que se refleja en todo lo que crean y hacen. Por todo ello, el Premio de Diseño Industrial viaja a la capital del estado grande de México, Chihuahua.

Este grupo ha capturado la atención de los jueces, por su eficiencia, identidad y determinación que imprimen en cada acción. Ellos nos recuerdan que las raíces y el origen son el motor de la excelencia. Tienen cohesión, enfoque estratégico y trascienden más allá del taller. Cuando el talento se combina con una identidad sólida, el resultado es una fuerza imparable que eleva el nivel de toda la competencia. Con las ventiscas del Espinal llegan con fuerza a la región lagunera, trayendo consigo un aire fresco de innovación que le gana a la arena. Los jueces quedamos impresionados con ellos.

Es un honor reconocer la extraordinaria agilidad de un equipo que, en tan solo su primer año, ha logrado activar la curiosidad de su comunidad por los valores STEAM, han derribado el mito de la inexperiencia, demostrando con creces que un equipo rookie no tiene límites y que el impacto real se construye con visión, trabajo y valentía para su primer desafío.

Hay equipos que compiten… y hay equipos que deciden levantarse, reinventarse y volver a creer en todo lo que pueden llegar a ser. Este equipo transformó los retos en propósito y convirtió cada obstáculo en una oportunidad para inspirar. Su nueva historia no se mide solo en resultados, sino en vidas: un impacto profundo en múltiples comunidades, alcanzando a miles de personas y dedicando incontables horas a encender la chispa de la ciencia en quienes más lo necesitan. Hoy representan el verdadero espíritu de resiliencia, crecimiento y visión que define a FIRST Robotics Competition. Porque no solo regresaron… regresaron más fuertes, con un propósito claro y un futuro brillante. Por su extraordinaria transformación y el profundo impacto que hoy dejan en su comunidad, este equipo nos recuerda que cuando se cree de nuevo, todo es posible.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Este equipo desarrolla prácticas con un impacto real en las personas y en su comunidad, sembrando acciones que contribuyen a la prosperidad de nuestro mundo. A través de sus programas, encienden una luz de esperanza en su entorno con un firme compromiso de servicio hacia los demás. Promueven y mantienen de forma permanente una sólida cultura de reciclaje en su escuela, y además fortalecen su legado a través de un semillero de estudiantes interesados en seguir su camino. Su sentido de pertenencia es inquebrantable. Inspirados en el universo de los cómics, y al igual que los grandes superhéroes, trabajan con toda su fuerza y con el corazón para ayudar a los demás y generar un impacto positivo.

Desde el norte del país llega un equipo que ha demostrado que el verdadero espíritu de FIRST se vive al compartir, inspirar y construir comunidad. Con iniciativa, vocación de servicio y una resiliencia ejemplar, han llevado el STEAM a quienes más lo necesitan, logrando sumar a seis nuevos equipos a esta gran familia. Porque el team spirit no solo los define, sino que se mide por el impacto que dejan en los demás. Su entusiasmo, colaboración, orgullo, unión y compromiso los han traído hasta aquí, representando con identidad y alegría una insignia azul que los une y los distingue: el sarape.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: El trabajo, la dedicación y la disciplina son constantes esenciales para alcanzar la excelencia y convertir los sueños en realidad. Estos valores se hacen presentes tanto en quienes cuentan con amplia experiencia como en quienes apenas comienzan su camino. Desde el Estado Grande de México… hoy la excelencia brilla con fuerza en la comunidad de Guadalupe y Calvo

Ellos llegaron desde el espacio armados con hilo, tela y pintura, no solo para crear, sino para apoyar a otros equipos y demostrar que las estrellas no solo brillan en el cielo, también lo hacen aquí, en la Tierra. Desde la tierra del mariachi y con una resiliencia admirable, este equipo es un ejemplo vivo de Gracious Professionalism: competir con excelencia, colaborar con generosidad y brillar sin dejar de levantar a los demás.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Siguiendo la guía de su capitán, este equipo ha logrado transformar una simple inicial en un símbolo que vuela alto, dentro y fuera del campo. Hoy celebramos a quienes convierten tradición, liderazgo y creatividad en algo verdaderamente inolvidable.

Inspirados en la velocidad, la resistencia y un espíritu ágil que nunca se detiene, transformaron ideas en un robot confiable y robusto. Con constancia, atención al detalle y una pasión evidente por hacer las cosas bien, este equipo demuestra que la velocidad no está reñida con la calidad. Desde Metepec, nos recuerdan que la excelencia se construye paso a paso. Por ello, el ganador del Quality Award es el robot Speedy.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Hoy celebramos a un equipo que ha sabido integrar talento, visión, disciplina y pasión, logrando que la tecnología no solo funcione, sino que inspire y se transforme en verdadera innovación. En esta competencia, el Galardón en Innovación y Control se vuelve regio. Un equipo de borregos que ha dejado huella en cada competencia, destacando por su liderazgo y trabajo colaborativo, y representando lo mejor de la juventud y la ingeniería con su robot Rollout.

Hoy reconocemos a un equipo que comprendió que la autonomía es mucho más que líneas de código: es confianza, estrategia y una preparación impecable. Su robot piensa, decide y ejecuta sin ayuda… y lo hace de manera extraordinaria. Un equipo multicampeón que ha elevado el nivel de la competencia y se ha convertido en fuente de inspiración para muchos más. Porque incluso en el desierto, la innovación florece… y hoy florece desde la Comarca Lagunera.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Este equipo no solo construyó una identidad visual; logró encapsular el alma de su comunidad en un solo logotipo. Su emblema es un manifiesto de orgullo por la biodiversidad local. Al portar en su escudo el refugio de una de las aves más emblemáticas de la sierra, demuestran que el diseño también puede ser un acto de amor por el territorio. Desde su santuario de guacamayas, este equipo nos recuerda que la identidad, cuando es auténtica, trasciende cualquier frontera, desde Uruachi, Chihuahua

As their city name connotes, this team has demonstrated toughness and durability. Building roots beyond their robot, this team has branched out to spread FIRST to 55 Lego league teams., dedicated 15 hours of outreach per team member, and design adaptive, sensory friendly STEM tools for students with learning differences. Congratulations to Catawba County’s longest running team.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team’s commitment to diversity and community outreach has revived the reach and impact of STEM throughout their region. They understand that true mentorship means empowering younger students—ensuring upper class members teach, guide, and uplift rather than take over. Rising from humble beginnings, this team has rebuilt, reimagined, and risen from the graveyard ashes to inspire everyone around them.

This team’s robot is a series of elegant, efficient, and practical components. The design has a succession of fuel gathering to double-barreled shooting. From doesn’t follow function, Both are in order for industrial design.

Sometimes the judges see a team that makes us pause and ask: “wait, how did they do that?” Because gravity is a mere suggestion to them, they scaled new heights and pulled their alliance partners up with them. And, they could do it again, and again, and again…

Every year, rookie teams arrive ready to learn. But, this team showed up ready to compete. They charged boldly in the challenge and demonstrated what FIRST stands for. With creativity and teamwork, they proved that even the smallest particles can generate big power.

One team stepped up to prove they are ready to soar among the best. They summoned the power and strength to triple their membership in a single year. By hosting a recent competition, they are already making an impact that can be felt across the sky.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: When wandering through the dark passage ways with little time, this team finds their way though maze to solutions to keeping their team going. They plan for succession by actively cultivating subteams to pass on knowledge, and creatively search for new recruits and sponsors. Uphill, downhill, all they, are leading the way for sustainability.

When the energy circles above the arena and hits its peak, you know something powerful has arrived. This team could hardly contain their enthusiasm when speaking proudly about their team. Bold, booming and running at their prime, they don’t just bring spirit, they transform the entire area and soar as a force that lifts everyone around them.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: When problems pile up, well-engineered ideas come crashing through. A storm of gears, code, and complete integration was layout out in a well-managed engineering process. The result was an overwhelming landslide that stopped the competition.
When other teams are up a river without a paddle, this team will give you theirs. Sharing key parts, they helped to keep another competitor afloat. They are always ready to bail you out.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team included a clever feature to help their robot soar. Their triple shooter enabled their fuel to stay in sync while in flight. This team is green and gold with creativity.
This team’s hard work created a design that really flowered. Performing well throughout the jungle of competition. They charged ahead, creating a tough and durable machine.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Three 7’s wins a jackpot in Vegas. A fully-automated turret and cameras provided this team with commanding and innovative controls to win the jackpot in Asheville. This team is no stranger to the award platform.

When the light turns green, and the robot has full freedom, choices really do matter. This team’s machine routine ran bug-free, and took full advantage of the time. The robot gathered fuel for the match without a hiccup.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Every great team starts with a plan and a great hat. This is not about stealing treasure from the museum, this team goaway with pickpocketing. This is no mystery: this team got away with prize; and you’ll remember them for it.

In the mountains, there are stories of a legendary creature — rarely seen, but known by the impact it leaves behind. Huge footprints. A presence felt across the entire region. Over the past three years, this team has left footprints of their own. They have dedicated nearly 20 thousand hours to outreach over the past three years. In the 25/26 season, they have reached more than 16,000 students through demos and presentations, ultimately inspiring epic numbers of people to explore STEM. They’ve launched and mentored numerous FIRST teams, expanded robotics into underserved schools, and powered events across their community. Get ready to brace for their IMPACT as the legend steps out of the shadows. The 2026 FIRST Impact Award goes to Team 3506 — YETI Robotics.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team’s inspiration keeps building. Through outreach and mentorship, they encourage others to take the climb into engineering and STEM. Nearly doubling their team members, they organize strong subteams, carefully track and measure their impact, mentor FTC and FLL teams, and volunteer at events while bringing together students from both in-state and out-of-state communities. For creating a landslide of commitment to FIRST and innovation within their team and community, and qualifying to compete for the Engineering Inspiration Award at the North Carolina State Championship is: 2724, Avalanche.

From start to finish, this team’s design is elegant, efficient, and effective. They expertly traversed the field, keeping competition trapped and unable to score. They might appear simple from the outside, but be careful, you might get lost in their maze!
Birds of a feather fly together. This flock helps all birds across the spectrum. The Judge’s Award for Helping Those with ASD Soar goes to Team 9005, Avian Robotics.

Anyone’s first time building a robot can be a bad dream, but this team has kept the competition from hitting the snooze button. With plenty of determination, they quickly proved themselves on the field. They’ve turned their season into a dream start! Qualifying to compete for the Rookie All-Star Award at the District Championship is: Team Number: 11377, Knightmare Robotics

Rising from the ashes, this team has stormed through the competition. Their membership has doubled in size and they have spread their wings throughout the community. These birds are flying as high as the stars!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team proves that even robots can help take care of the planet. With creative ideas and a big green heart, this team runs smoothly. Their sustainability initiatives ensure their team will continue to run without a Glitch!

A byte-size spark rises from a county where big ideas grow. When their school faced closure, the students advocated to the school Board, preserving opportunities for future innovators. They spread FIRST principles by hosting workshops on storm science, as storms recently impacted their region. Last year, 99 percent of their team’s graduates chose STEM, strengthening their community’s future. Oh, do they have Mega Spirit!

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team’s functional and clean robot doesn’t just stab-stab the challenge with its tines, but also scoops up the success. Good thing this team brought their own cutlery to eat up the competition!

There is more to this team that meets the eyes. When a nearby team was still brewing their first cup of bot, they poured out the know-how. For a venti serving of collaboration and keeping Gracious Professionalism on tap, we congratulate Team 6894, Iced Java.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team found creativity in simplicity. While other teams were hunting for extra motors, this team was clever and efficient with their single power source. It’s proof that, in the hands of a masked bandit, two motors is a masterclass in doing more with less.

When other teams were cooling down, this team was heating up. They peppered the hub with a reliable intake, delivery, and a shooting system that held up well against their spicy competition. This robot was fabricated to go “all the way” and didn’t need any additional mustard.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: For this team, finding the target is less about magic, and more about a high-speed game of April-tag. By fusing real-time camera localization with an automated turret and precision roller control, they’ve turned a complex aiming sequence into a single seamless gesture for the driver. They didn’t just automate the shot, they engineered a masterpiece of wizardry that hits the mark most every time.
This team jumps into play and lands on their feet. Running over the hump and scoring fuel in the hub consistently leads to a PURRRfect start. They quickly geared up in autonomous!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Unearth brilliance and reveal hidden gems—because sometimes the greatest discoveries are found beneath the surface. This team shows that what appears to be rugged on the outside can hold brilliance from within. They show that, like hidden discoveries, talents shine brightest once uncovered.

By fostering a cycle of giving and receiving, this team empowers others to soar alongside them…. This team ignites the next generation and acts as the heart, spine, and brain of their community. Using their dragon spirit to drive unity and sustainable change, they have shown that their impact extends far beyond the competition field.

records.awardName: District Championship Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: The spirit of lifting others extends far beyond their sloop. This team has unearthed their potential from the graveyard, and have transformed their wreckage into a fortified flagship that leads the entire fleet.

records.awardName: District Championship Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team really spiked our interest with their many efforts to inspire imagination. They have earned this recognition for their outstanding success in advancing respect and appreciation for engineering within their local community. When it comes to building a team and spreading STEM far and wide, these competitors are the gold standard.

When this team set out to build their robot, they didn't fly too close to the sun — they engineered something that could actually handle the heat. Their turret design lets them stay in the fight offensively while holding the line defensively, all without missing a beat. Like the craftsman of ancient myth, this team built their machine with ingenuity and purpose, proving that true artistry lies in solving problems before they arise. From the East, these builders have constructed something worthy of legend.
This team is always mining for hidden gems on their team. From the inside out, they build, inspire, share, and innovate. Their light shines bright with our FIRST judges for the Judges Award.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This noble rookie team quickly built a strong foundation through meaningful partnerships and a clear commitment to inspiring students in science and technology. They supported other teams, reached out to their community, and created opportunities for younger students to get involved. Despite the challenges of starting a new program, they have shown determination and the strength of armor for future generations.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: In their first season, this team built more than a robot - they built opportunity, raising their own funding for program growth. Their outreach reflects a deep commitment to inclusion, connecting with students and families making STEM more accessible. They have earned this award for their initiative of iron, sustainability and dedication to making their community better.

This team missed the memo that said young teams are supposed to struggle, because they've been leading by example since day one! Their positive presence and relentless; commitment is felt by all in the pits. Setting a strong standard for other emerging teams, this group of friends shining example of what a team can accomplish when they lead with heart.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team never stops chomping, They’re saving the planet by recycling and building open source software. They ensure no student is ever left behind by covering membership and travel costs. Its Game Over when they build up people and communities.
Flying through the sky, spreading their enthusiasm all around. Wanting to rollout and expand their community. This team transforms the first ecosystem.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: Building a robot is like a culinary art. Without a recipe perfected and documented over time, the result is bland. This team iterated their hopper, optimized the serializer and made a beautiful engineered design. Their documentation ensures the best recipes and variations along the way are passed to future team members, assuring excellence.

Like a woven mosaic where every piece connects in a seamless progression, this team builds success with purpose, consistency, and drive. They exemplify Gracious Professionalism by opening their build space, sharing their tools, and empowering other teams to succeed alongside them. Step by step, they transform collaboration into impact that strengthens the entire community.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: There's something a little odd about this team — in the best possible way. They seamlessly juggle movement, fuel collection, and firing all at once, guided by a pair of ever-watchful eyes that never lose sight of their target no matter where it goes. Like the divine force behind the forge, their machine strikes with precision from any angle. Three times the ingenuity, three times the innovation —

In circuits that shine and systems that glide, Precision-built robots show power and pride. Their Spindexer spins smooth, steady, and true, Handling game pieces with ease all match through. A turret turns clean, simple and tight, Everything built to work just right.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team swallowed a ton of information to control their continuously shooting bot. They always know where they are and use adaptive path following and advanced dynamic targeting to score and score some more. Use of the Chinese Remainder Theorem at first sounded fishy, but really hooked the judges.

Navigating the field's terrain like an advanced self-driving mountain rover, this BOT gets to work before most robots have even said "hello". With sharp autonomous programming and confidence from the very first second, this machine races out, gathers fuel, lines up and fires with impressive consistency and then some. Smart, fast and built to deliver under pressure, this robot helped power its team all the way to the top of in the competition.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Orange to the core, black like the drive. From the mascot to the outfits, it’s a way of life. Peel back the competition and what’s left? Slice clean and precise.

From scales of green and circuits of code, this team brings a dragon to life. Their wings carry ideas into their community through park and corporate outreach. Like the spine, brain, and heart of a dragon, they move with unity. They are recognized for spreading impact far beyond the competition field. Through giving and receiving grants, they grow both their team and their community. Their mini FRC camps ignite curiosity and build the next generation. This team embodies what it means to lead, inspire, and sustain change. Their dragon doesn’t just roar—it uplifts others to soar. Congratulations to Team 4561 Terror Bytes.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: High above the robco fields, this team takes flight with purpose and creativity, embodying their motto to reach new heights. Their bot is off the leash and this is not the FIRST major award this team has won. A unique team structure empowers every team to lead to touch diverse communities through inclusive STEM events featuring their extraordinary bot. Congratulations to Team 6729, RobCoBots.

A team inspired by the power of three arrived with a truly distinctive identity. Their robot’s architecture showcases a harmonious blend of efficiency, elegance, and creativity. This trio-driven group, known for their unconventional and quirky style, made their mark unmistakably clear. Congratulations to Team 1533 Triple Strange.

They are the connectors in their community, always ready to share knowledge and spark curiosity. This team brings people together, forming meaningful bonds through outreach. They have gone above and beyond in service, dedicating countless hours to mentoring, outreach, and uplifting others. Their impact grows and inspires from classrooms to community events. This team has truly stood out to the judges for their dedication, excellence, and service. Their work strengthens not only their team, but everyone around them. The Judges Award goes to Team 8429, Valence.

High above the field, a bold flock took flight. The Flying Fowls soared with determination and teamwork. Their energy lifted the entire competition. As newcomers, they embraced every challenge with creativity. They reimagined their intake and refined their hopper with smart innovation. Their solutions showed both courage and engineering excellence. Their journey marks the beginning of something special. Their wings are just starting to spread. Congratulations to Team 11146, Citrus Duckz.

They are a young team with their sights set high, learning to soar with every challenge. Their journey is defined by growth, determination, and an eagerness to improve. They have shown remarkable development, embracing mentorship and building strength in both skill and spirit. They are quickly setting a high standard for other emerging teams to follow. This team represents the future of excellence and leadership in this program. Their progress and spirit have not gone unnoticed. The Rising All-Star Award goes to Team EagleTron.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This poky team's work extends beyond the season, rooted in learning and sharing year-round. They have invested in people through their support of FTC and FLL teams. They have protected the planet through recycling initiatives. In a workshop framed by blue and yellow, these spiky builders turn gears into progress. Congratulations to Team 587 Hedgehogs!

There is something truly remarkable inside this team and they aim to find the gem inside of everybody. They champion inclusivity, equality, and true teamwork. Through their actions and positivity, they help build a stronger, more connected community. This team sparkles with spirit, unity, and heart in all they do. Bro, Chill. You got this. The Team Spirit Award goes to Team 8757, GeodeBots.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: Competing with unmatched intensity over two days, this local squad blazed through both the arena and the pits. Through rigorous prioritization, constant reevaluation, and extensive prototyping, these STEM leaders transformed countless hours of trial and error into a truly hot bot. By setting a new standard for excellence in engineering, they brought their signature "Power in Pink" to the halls of Elon. Congratulations to Team 2640, HOTBOTZ!

In a swirl of green and black, this team moves with quiet intensity and purpose. Like a dragon weaving through a bustling shopping mall, they stand out while lifting others up. They embody Gracious Professionalism by opening their practice field to many teams, creating space for collaboration and shared success. They learn from others because they share, knowing that generosity strengthens everyone. Following a path as elegant and deliberate as the Fibonacci sequence, their impact grows with every step. Team 7890 Sequence have set the standard for what it means to compete with integrity and heart. Congratulations to Team 7890 Sequence.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Using iterative design, They refined, rebuilt, and returned stronger each time. This green and black engineering team stood out with a powerful triple shooter. They also designed an uplifting climber that is uplifting raising their bot above all others. Their innovation reflects both imagination and technical skill. Congratulations to the Team 7918 Recursion.

In circuits that gleam and systems that slide, Precision-built systems show power and pride. Their Spindexer spins with precision so fine, Extendable intake and turret align in design divine. A dynamic climber and swerve modules glide, Congratulations Team 6502 Darc Side.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team may be hard to spot in the wild, but their engineering ingenuity is impossible to miss. Their robot pinpoints its position on the field and automatically calculates every shooting parameter and functionality. They were metered in their design with offset rollers to prevent jamming and a contracting hopper to compress the balls for cleaner shots. Like the legendary creature of the frozen mountains, this team's big footprints left their mark on the field of play. Congratulations Team 3506 Yeti.

This team’s autonomous operation uses its field position to dynamically calculate all shooting parameters in real time. A single button is all it takes for the robot to decide whether to intake or shoot based on exactly where it stands. Truly, their performance has been anything but egg-shaped — it's been a perfect oval of precision that keeps their game running smooth and round the clock! Congratulations team 4795 Eastbots!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team emerges from the shadowy digital underworld striking fear in the CPUs of their competition. Their cybernetic warriors dominate their opponents with imagery of a singularly focused vision and powerful tridents. This team is fully committed to leaving a lasting visual impression on everyone who sees them. Congratulations to Team 9607, Cyber Demons.
Blazing onto the field with a spark that can’t be contained. They earned this honor by igniting inspiration and driving meaningful community impact. Like fire, they spread energy wherever they go.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: From ocean depths, they rise and make strong waves with a sweeping tail. They swim into communities where STEM sets sail. A deep-sea force whose inspiration tips the scale.
This robot is clean, powerful, and brilliantly simple. Every mechanism reflects a relentless focus on reliability and serviceability. Proof that the best design is bold KISS

This team’s bite matched their bold leap into the unknown. Their bold, triangular designs bring strength and creativity that stand apart. They experiment fearlessly and make triangles their signature.
Every great team starts by forging its identity, From FTC roots, they spread FIRST while growing stronger every step, They set sail with a purpose and inspired others along the way.
When things seemed to be at their darkest point... Team members rallied to rebuild on their own terms. This team is now on a meteoric rise.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: With precise thought processes and planning, their sustainability goals for people, prosperity, and planet mesh like well-machined gears. We didn't need a computer algorithm to make this choice.
From jungle shadows, they set the pace. Their cheers erupt and fill the space. This spotted fierce team claims first place.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: In a field of fierce competitors, this team engineered solutions with both precision and creativity. Their detailed documentation showcased a thoughtful, iterative engineering process from concept to competition. With the cleverness and agility of a fox, their performance truly stood out.

In a field of competitors, this team kept things secure—blocking bad data and letting only good vibes through. By generously sharing their scouting data, they prove it's better to connect, not just protect. Powering up every alliance, this team truly lived up to their name!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: These shamans of mechatronics spellbound the judges with their well implemented innovations. Not ones to "SITS" on their hands, They agitated their competition and directed their fuel with their screwy creation.

This team took flight with a clear focus on building excellence that endures. Their machine demonstrated remarkable resilience and flexibility, backed by a meticulous quality plan, spare-part preparation, and durability testing. They built not just one but two extra robots.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team honors their ingenuity, with a mascot forged from the strongest metal Their innovative control systems were sharp as claws, and they let their code roar! They showed us the true evolution of innovation in control
From the first second, this team is precise and in control. They dominate with fast, accurate, and reliable autonomous runs. This is autonomy at its best!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Fueled by citrus and a little robotic quack, they soared from the pits to the field, bringing zest, teamwork, and unstoppable energy.

Furthering connectivity and curiosity, this team’s rapid expansion extends beyond its central core. Strong bonds, formed by students for students, energize people, programs and communities. Their core nucleus and their atomic energy have earned them this years’ FIRST Impact Award.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Like their spiky-headed mascot carefully exploring new ground, this team has rolled into their community with curiosity and purpose—opening doors to engineering for students who might not have seen themselves in robotics before. Through intentional outreach and programs that uplift Latinx, Black, and students with disabilities, they are helping a more diverse generation discover that they belong in the world of innovation. They are expanding appreciation for engineering and growing a more inclusive FIRST community.

Steel on the outside and precision within, this robot shows craftsmanship from frame to pin. CNC crafted parts and a layout so neat, it makes strength and organization hard to beat. A triple shooter fires while a 6-part linkage turns with smooth rotation in motion. Therefore, this award is for rugged beauty and engineering detail.
Under the big top of competition, this team has juggled every challenge with grit and determination. The Judges award is for perseverance, creativity, and unwavering teamwork

This team is wonderfully starting out its first year espousing the princely core values of FIRST North Carolina. They have overcome the odds of working in rural NC, and have become an alliance lead, through their passion, teamwork and confidence.

Like the bright spinning pinwheels in the North Carolina breeze, this young team has turned challenges into motion—growing, building, and learning with every turn. In just their second season, they’ve doubled in size, and despite limited funding, crafted creative robot solutions powered by persistence and imagination. This team gets the award for proving that determination can keep the blades turning no matter the wind.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team is on fire, sparking a legacy that keeps spreading. Through FLL mentorship, igniting student leadership, and lighting up their impact around the world, they champion people, prosperity, and the planet. This team keeps the flame burning bright for sustainability.
At FIRST, everyone is friends, buddies and pals. The power of your passion was contagious and energizing. It’s amazing how far you have come in your Rookie year to win the Team Spirit Award.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: With a turret that spins and a shooter on sight, this team tracks their targets with power and might. An intake extends, their hopper slides right, while cameras and Kalman filtering keep every shot right. With their smart COTS design and a climber taking flight

All weekend, in the whir of gears and the glow of bright screens, this team moved through the pits and playing field like well-oiled helpers, by supporting others, sharing knowledge, and proving that kindness can power a robot just as much as code. Their enthusiasm flowed like electricity through the event; offering a helping hand and showing that true strength in robotics comes from teamwork and respect. With every team high-five, quick repair, and encouraging word, they embodied the spirit of Gracious Professionalism both on and off the field.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation

Their three year strategy is concluding as a complete success, and they’re doing it right, just like a Cyberknight.

records.awardName: District Championship Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award

This team extends FIRST’s impact globally, even helping fundraise thousands of dollars. This ONE BIG FAMILY embodies the Rookie All-Star Award.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Burns Division presented by GlobalFoundries

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Burns Division presented by GlobalFoundries

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Burns Division presented by GlobalFoundries

Hearing about how this team is setting themselves up for the future will surely leave a smile on your face.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Burns Division presented by GlobalFoundries

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Burns Division presented by GlobalFoundries

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Burns Division presented by GlobalFoundries

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This teams complete engineering process creates momentum to solve this year’s game challenge. records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation

Designing a robot that is clearly robust while still underweight is a true challenge. This team's CAD stress-testing of all components gave them a robot that can "hang in there" against heavy wave action.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team's control system was unique and effective. Scoring in autonomous from anywhere on the field, this team strategically worked within their own zone. Dynamically planning each autonomous route, Horris kept his eye on the goal.

This team stood out for their accurate and defense-resistant shooter. Using AprilTag localization, this team's robot flies over the bump before firing a deluge of fuel. Truly fitting for a machine in black and yellow, they Bee-lined around the field.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team projects their image as one of excellence, creativity, and community pride, leaving a lasting impression both on and off the field, even participating in parades and baby gender reveals. In their 30th anniversary season, this team truly flies above the competition.

This team has transformed from a pillar of their community to a pillar of the FIRST world community. Their reach expands to continents, mentoring and supporting not just teams but communities from across the global. At home they support foodbanks, drama clubs, and movie nights - just to name a few. What wowed the judges was not that they just reach out for opportunities to help, but are actively sought after to help across the globe. Their reach is truly unending, just like the numbers after 3.14159...

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: From elementary classrooms to high schools, this team builds a powerful pipeline shaping the future of STEM. They have reached thousands through FRC events alone and extended their impact across borders to schools worldwide. Dressed in yellow and black, they don’t just stand out—they light the way for schools and communities alike. This team truly embody Engineering Inspiration.

The judges appreciate the beefiness of an exceptional robot. These cats have taken the concept of protection and self-preservation to another level! We were really impressed by their use of machined U-M-H-W.

The judges love to see how teams embrace and promote FIRST core values, especially when they welcome, aid, and encourage other area teams. We love to recognize teams that think and act “out of the box”. The judges award for a “FRESH Approach”...

Formed by students from different schools, this rookie team turned diversity into strength and built a unified team from the ground up. They're rising to the top just after one event - showing incredible growth in a short time. Their perseverance, teamwork, and dedication to the FIRST mission highlight a team with both impact and a bright future. They truly embody what it means to be a Rookie All-Star.

They were left with just two, where once there were many together in the mix. Improving team morale under pressure singing and dancing works as a hotfix. This year they rise again as a cardinal, bright as a phoenix.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: From middle school halls to the competition floor, Each year they plant ten more. FLL to Vex, Arduino to FTC, A pipeline built deliberately. Veterans teach, newcomers learn, Community outreach at every turn. Metal scraps returned to earth, Every build has earned their second worth. They don’t just compete, they grow and repeat.

This team creates a welcoming and inclusive environment where members and new teammates feel comfortable, supported and encouraged to participate. Their strong spirit, teamwork and commitment to including everyone reflect what FIRST is all about, right down to the "canucks and bolts"

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team started this season by planning different ways to solve this year's challenge. Through a team process, this team played different roles their robot could fill. These cats know how to make a plan!
They don’t just speak - they help out in the rink, When someone needs a hand, they never raise a stink, Outstanding on the field - even on one leg in pink.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Indexer, spindexer, cakedexer, oh my! Energy chain and belt tensioners, but why? Barking creativity makes things all right!
This robot was designed down to the type of materials used. From the chassis to the feeder to every part of this machine, this team made a plan "1st". For a well thought out plan for robustness....

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team's controls are cooking! From hot electrical and mechanical with extreme lighting, they innovated all the way!

The judges are always impressed when a team targets success in the competition and has googly eyes. We also appreciate this team's use of artifacts to establish consistency with the Rebuilt theme. Who would have thought that king crabs could shoot?

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team's Dino-Mite integration of their first core values into their image led from the seas to the competition fields. When we look at this team, we don't see a dinosaur of the past, we see the future of FIRST. With their past mapped out behind them their future looks golden.

The judges recognize the wide-reaching impact that this team has on its local community and beyond with numerous outreach initiatives designed to recruit, teach and inspire. Whether keeping appliances out of the landfill or building Rube Goldberg machines, this team brings STEM out of the garage into the public. When rolling up to an event this team embraces their grouchy side and openly invites the public to observe its operations.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team demonstrates a strong commitment to spreading the message of FIRST. Whether it is starting up FLL teams, sending out STEM kits around the world, or teaching local elementary school students about engineering, they get the next generation prepared for the future. No matter what the challenge, this team is sure to pass the TEST.

This team chose to to focus on shooting a lot of fuel accurately. Like armor and shield, this team reinforced their large intake. These knights lead the charge to victory with their robustly designed robot.

For this team, safety is not just a priority, it's a core value. From safety trainings to tucking in their drawstrings, they stand out! These T-birds are watching out for everyone's safety on and off the field.

With thoughts of community and impact, this team is on an upward trajectory. This team continues on, using everything they can get their hands on. From STEM activities to makerfests, their academies can build it all.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team cares about each other and the environment Their PILLARS will show you the way. Just follow the BULLDOG and you will learn how to build and keep supporting a team.

From the pit to the bleachers, and from their robot to their handmade pins and matching attire, this team of besties has demonstrated team spirit in all aspects! Their spirit is FIREY, though they surely aren't SOUR

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team is plugged into the process of finding solutions. They made design a game, well documented, and easy to communicate. They ROLLED well on the traits for their Robot Dora.

This team arrives to compete in their blue uniforms. They know the competition is not just about doing good, but recognizing others who do it. If you've received a totem from them, maybe you could ask them for a Hawaiian shirt.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: We want to let the cat out of the bag on this design. Why make two components when one can do all you need. Watch out for the Trap Door!

This team integrates mechanical, electrical, & programming subteams into the design of each robot system. Their documentation draws a clear picture of their success Watch out, these cats are about to pounce!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team refined hardware and software to navigate with precision Advanced vision with data syncs allowed their bot to move with intent Their quest to map the field with sensor fusion allowed MEDUSA to truly master the competition and reign supreme.
This team was FLYING around the competition. Using their camera to autonomously drive and position themselves on the field, Watch out for the STING of the robot.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team serves as one of the pillars of FMA. From pit to bot, they bring their local community with the to competition. Decorated head to toe, hopefully we'll see their flowers and fossils again soon.

The Judges are always amazed at the sheer volume and breadth of FIRST Team’s growth and engagement within their local communities, the greater FIRST Community and the world at large. Whether it be through mentoring, public demonstrations, international outreach, or mental health initiatives - this team just checks all our boxes.
