records.script: This team believes they can change the world by engaging in STEM projects that enhance people’s lives, while developing leaders for the future. When visiting their pit, the judges were surrounded by high quality in every aspect, from the excellence of their robot components to the professional demeanour and expertise of every student. When it comes to demonstrating quality in everything they do, this team shows their TRUE COLOURS.

records.eventName: FIRST Ontario Provincial Championship - Technology Division
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Fuel jams had many teams stuck between a rock and a hard place. This team built a unique mechanical indexer, so their fuel’s path was set in stone. The rock-solid auger smoothly fed fuel, match after match.

records.eventName: FIRST Ontario Provincial Championship - Technology Division
records.script: While others were flying blind, this team stayed wide awake, watching from every angle, and hunting with predatory precision. Their wise engineering created a multi-tasking marvel through relentless design iteration with eagle-eyed focus. They don’t just work around the clock, they own the night, and their quick, efficient performance shows wisdom beyond measure.

records.eventName: FIRST Ontario Provincial Championship - Technology Division
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This recently rebuilt team is always shifting, adapting and moving forward. Their team colour, logo and theme flow throughout their team, machine, and pit. This team is making waves with their outstanding aesthetic.

When it comes to impact, this team leaves no stone unturned. With superb recruitment and succession planning, they have rebuilt and almost doubled their team size. Do they hesitate about digging in to help seniors with tech or sharing their practice field? No. In fact, it’s quite the inverse.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: The judges were impressed with the winning team’s devotion to post-season training and mentoring initiatives. Beyond their excellent local presence, they are able to inspire other robotics teams globally. Among many strong contenders, the judges are convinced that this team is the absolute best.

This team has impressed everyone with its sleek design, it’s incredible functionality, and it’s “make it rain” efficiency. They have managed to score under all conditions. They came with a machine that is not a doctor, but amazingly, it OP…erates.

This team clawed their way through a rookie season and are back this year for more. A FUR-midable team in their own right, they are proud to be a safe, welcoming den for new Canadian cubs. As the biggest club in their school, their mission is creating a sense of belonging. With passion like this, their future really is “sans frontieres” a big round of aPAWs for this team!

In their first year, this team has spread the FIRST core values and overcome many challenges. While setting up networks for collaboration and recruitment, they have shown they have a backbone of steel. This team is committed to building the culture of FIRST and are here for the long haul.

With determination, this team has resurfaced and caught the judges attention. Through ebbs and flows, they created a competition ready team. With their passion, safety, commitment, and support for feeder teams... like the tide, this team is rising.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team proves that when it comes to innovation, the sky is not the limit, it’s just the launchpad. Their focus on student leadership and mentorship is out of this world. Their aim to leverage recycled parts and materials ensures they don't just burn bright, but also for a long time.

This team is proud to promote STEM education throughout their whole community. Throwing a golden wrench into the competition, their team spreads spirit by celebrating others with their own award! From their pit, to the shop, Europe, to even their local potato festival, their spirit shines through.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team crushed the launch design and the execution. They had an electric presence on the field with a design that ensured they were never in a jam. This team left the judges wondering, “who turned the lights out on the competition”?

This team leads with purpose. Their growth mindset and ambitious innovative vision project is commendable. Leading both on the field as well as off the field, they readily share their designs and spare parts. Spreading the true spirit of gratuitous professionalism is far from luck when it comes to this team.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team’s creativity has left its mark. Their magnetic approach pulled the judges in and allowed them to find their way to the top. Their creative design is worthy of a thunderous applause.

This team caught the judge’s attention with their design; ensuring robustness throughout the entire competition. Their intake, spin-dexer, and shooter remained consistent with their philosophy of simplicity. It’s impressive how this team thinks outside of the fox.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team has an eye for localization. They map their environment 120 times per second, making virtual reality a FIRST reality. With their oculus VR, they see the big picture and are poised to strike.
This mythic peninsula team plays this game like no other. Their impressive performance scores 50+ points in autonomous mode with ease. Everyone should be proud of Simbot Tim.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team has a brand we can see and they combined it with this year’s theme. Their imagery is well integrated across all their activities with the assistance of their mascot. This green machine has whip-ped up a theme that is sure to put every team in the adventuring spirit.

This Team is working to make STEM fully accessible to everyone, including underserved communities and seniors. This mission has reached over 5,000 students throughout Canada and the world. The significant number of outreach events and activities attests to this Team’s unity and passion to the FIRST mission. This Team sees technology as a means to better the lives of everyday people through such activities as cybersecurity, advocacy, post-secondary opportunities, and environmental education. When combined, they promote STEM, inspire interest in FIRST, and complete the circuit. The embodiment of this Team is found in their philosophy: Ubuntu (“oo-boon-tu”) - I am because we are.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team is joining together to build inclusive, robust, STEM programs. They go above and even beyond international borders to share FIRST’s mission and values across communities and cultures; reminding us that innovation thrives in diversity. This flock of inspirational competitors is helping shepherd the next generation of outstanding lambs into the future.

This team brings a machine to the field where precision, style and performance come together seamlessly. This robot features a clean, robust design and exceptional attention to detail. From spotless wiring to a rock solid build, every detail has been carefully crafted, like a well tended plant built to thrive under pressure.
With OMNI-flow and triple-show, they launch fast and never fold! From zero to hero, this team rides bold in black, blue and gold! This team didn’t just start strong - they went supernova!

This team may be young, but their passion runs deep. Small but ambitious, this team efficiently uses its resources to galvanize their school and broader community. Get your quarters ready as this team is ready to level up!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This explosive rural team flows efforts into tributaries to ensure their program thrives for the long run. From electronic recycling drives to their Mole day outreach, they remain interconnected in their community. The rivers of their efforts will flow resiliently for years to come.

This team has layers, You’ll dig their style! Erupting with enthusiasm, this down-to-earth team can weather any storm. They shower FIRST core values at competitions and within their community. This tight-knit team is in their purple era.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: The effervescent nature of this team’s cloud-based engineering approach helped them rise to the top. With improvements from match-to-match and their practical kick plate, this team are the architects of their own future!

This team is chosen not just ‘cause they are enthusiastically gracious and considerate on and off the field. They have a “gotta catch’em all” approach to STEM mentorship at home and abroad. Breaking stereotypes, they prove robots can be pretty in pink too!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team’s enchantingly defiant, mischief making charmer had the judges impressed by their shimmying skills. Their creative way to shake, rattle and roll the fuel in the robot had judges under their spell. This team got a perfect “10” for their devilish dancing moves.

Although this team’s name suggests they are architects of chaos, their robot was anything but. With clean lines, crisp colours and a wickedly organized robot, the machine didn’t just compete; it captivated. The robot set a scorching new standard for the judges.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: The opposition stood no chance against this team’s thunderous tail-slap. Their robot stood out for its robust simulation modeling, intelligent spatial navigation and comprehensive data logging. This team was as solid as a finished dam.

To cycle twice in the autonomous mode takes a fast robot. To control this speed with accurate shooting throughout the hunt takes the guile and intelligence of a canine. Sometimes a long journey is the best teacher.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team merges heavy-duty engineering with soft skills. Absorbing the values from FIRST, teachers and mentors, they burst with colour, energy and a sense of adventure. “Imagination!” is soaked into everything they do.

The judges were amazed at the outstanding depth and breadth of this team's outreach initiatives. They impacted all ages, levels of FIRST, and an extensive range of geographic locales. In the face of major adversity, this team showed remarkable resilience, drawing strength from their community to rebuild. The judges don't want to get 'SYRUP-Y', but they found this team to be 'WAFFLE-Y' good!

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team came in with a BANG! They always stand out when supporting teams in their local and FIRST community. This team inspiring everyone isn’t just a THEORY!

The judges were impressed by the team’s end-to-end approach to the design, strategy, and execution process. This team optimized subsystem layout and weight efficiency through advanced material selection. They had a bird’s eye view of the field to fuel-up, and they used their turret to strike with raptor-like precision.

This team of STARS wowed the judges by embracing the principles of FIRST. No amendments are needed with how these students lead their learning. Our judges were proud to BEAR witness to this exceptional team.

Driven by a shared passion for robotics, this team quickly found their flock. Eager to spread their wings, these students were determined to make STEAM more accessible to the broader community. It is safe to say this rookie team didn’t duck the challenge!
Starting small hasn’t stopped this team. They have EXPANDED and POPPED into role models in the FIRST community. Under the PRESSURE of the competition, this young team is rising to the top.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team is meticulously growing a community that connects students, building confidence and commitment to higher learning. From the moment their high school experience begins, members learn how to use and re-use everything they can to compete at the highest level. We invite you to SEE FOR yourself, how they sustainably drive their explosive success.
This team’s enthusiasm is a perfect 10! Their energy in the pits and stands was contagious, and their chants could be heard all across campus! Choosing them for this award was pure LOGIC!

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team really bared their fangs in the game field. Their engineering problem-solving really put them at the front of the pack, with incredible accuracy and a unique design. When it comes to excellence in engineering, this team is the top dog.

No matter the weather, this team embodies sportsmanship. They have graciously provided their support to stitch up other teams on and off the field. Hats off to this tight-knit group for EFFECT-ively demonstrating gracious professionalism.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Creativity is this Robot’s buried treasure! You need to do more than scratch the surface to see and understand this Robot’s hidden gems; it took cardboard to un-crate their final solution. This team didn't find the design, they built it, broke it, and rebuilt it 90 times until it was unstoppable.

This team is building on the legacy of those who came before. They used a strict design process and quality management system to build a high-quality robot. Grabbing the BULL by the horn, they charged ahead to rise above the competition.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team really BLUE the judges away! Before even hitting the field, simulation and data logging gave this team a competitive edge. The HUNT for the recipient for this award is over.

Together, this team stood firm despite adversity. To stay localized on the field, they had strategically placed limelights, but they all shared the spotlight. Standing united and strong, this team has demonstrated consistent autonomous capabilities.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team IGNITES excitement with it’s creativity and originality, building a strong foundation between its team, robot and community. It is hard to IGNORE their solid brand and commitment. They are Rockstars and continue to streak across the sky.

Their unique approach to address climate issues on waste reduction, food hydroponics, plastic recycling and air quality improvements are ready for introduction to scalable industries. Reaching for the stars, this team uplifts the world around them. This team maintains a high level Orbit in Impacting the transfer of knowledge through Planet-Moon peer mentoring.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team has spent more than a decade spreading the FIRST message and promoting STEM. They enthusiastically dart to the forefront be it by arriving early to the pits, influencing school curriculum or starting one of the first all-girls FTC teams in Ontario. By following their compass, this team need not edit the course they charted.

This team’s electro-mechanical design has outstanding performance on the field. Their CNC and 3D printed parts make their robot elegant and aesthetic. This pink team has demonstrated speed, scoring, and hanging well balanced to succeed.

This team has proven that a community team can out-innovate expectations and charm the judges along the way. They leveled up again and used VR innovation so cleverly to command their robot. For the always-fearless ever evolving team,

This team shines bright and was so strong it could compete in a number of categories with seasoned teams. One judge commented this was the best rookie they had seen in 15 years of judging. This team shall light up in Niagara.

This team made it their mission to open up the world of FIRST and STEM by removing economic barriers. This community team has overcome a complete rebuild and never lost sight of their charitable work. They bear the FIRST message and make stem accessible to all.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This community team has a big heart They cover the full field of people and prosperity to plan for a positive impact This team demonstrates that building a sustainable community team is not a paradox

You don’t have to dig too deep to find something to rave about this team. This team’s spirit soars at the competition, and when hatching new roboticists through FLL. Every morning when the doors opened, this team flocked enthusiastically to the stands.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team impressed the judges with a master class in custom fabrication. In addition to having machined metal components and 3D-printed parts, they used them in unexpected ways to solve unearthed problems. This team rose from the ashes of technical challenges to excel in engineering.

This team demonstrates a high-level of sportsmanship both on and off the field. They are colossal in supporting other teams with wiring guidance. They are the gold standard for gracious professionalism.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Archaeology is not simple but this team intentionally chose this approach. With new members in mind, they rebuilt their robot to be robust, efficient, and easy to use. A net can’t contain these cougars.

Originating from a “deep valley” this team delivers high performance play through a carefully crafted all black robot. This machine features an outstanding low-profile design with a neat system connectivity and precise secure wiring. They are known for “closing alt” their matches.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team proves that keeping things organized behind the scenes leads to putting massive points on the board. They engineered an innovative cable management and tool balancing system that keeps their controls hardware smooth, steady, and snag-free. They truly know how to make a shift on and off the field.

In the first 20 seconds of the match, this team was off to the races, leaving the competition in the dust with a perfectly programmed gait. Their robot didn’t just move, it galloped through two full cycles of scoring and finished with a precision climb. Their autonomous period is a key to their success.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team's identity is a perfect fit for this year’s archeological theme. They have clear visuals from the support in the stands to the team raiding the field. When it comes to imagery this goes berserk!

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This team is a global ambassador for FIRST and advocate for STEM. In fact, they wrote the book for it and boxed up their experience to share with others. This team has the right chemistry and formula for success. They are sharp, to the point and have the edge on the competition.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This Team has spun and unleashed itself on the competition. They are herding the community towards FIRST with their continuous outreach programs. From hosting a FIRST event to raising awareness about a disease this team has a vast scope of activities that are more than just building robots. This Pack has a DREAM, to mentor and inspire the future pups.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This team performed fiercely with their elegantly designed robot. Contrary to their name this team has demonstrated an outstanding level of professionalism in their design process. Powered by their emphasis on an efficient and reliable design they have a robot that follows all the rules.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: After a test of persistence, this team reshaped their future in this competition. Their quick thinking with makeshift materials made them the best fit for this award. With feline agility, this team landed on their feet!

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This young team made a splash in the competition. This year presented a lot of challenges to the team, which they overcame with community support. This team’s taken “fowl play” to a new level—geese and ducks teaming up for the ultimate power play.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team is our west side story. Building skills and developing new talent, they inspire young students for their future. When it comes to competing they know how to rumble.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This team brings the heat everywhere they go. With their mindset of forever recognizing others and celebrating greatness they spread spirit like flowing lava. They ignite enthusiasm and prove that spirit burns brightest when it’s shared.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team followed the most reliable and organized approach in their problem solving. They had their many heads set on excelling in all aspects of engineering, leaving no details behind. The seamless functionality of their robot was made possible by their multifaceted approach.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: Always on the prowl, this team hunts for ways to help everyone succeed. They move through the pits with a roaming support crew, offering a helping paw to all. As true examples of teamwork and support they are the leaders of the pack.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team surprised their competitors with ideas that slipped through defenses. Their vision system wasn’t just smart, it had confidence backed by a robust calibration process that they published. When matches get tough, their robot flies in like Maverick to save the day and support their alliance.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: This team worked hard on their robust robot to create a very reliable product. They designed a machine with a multiple shooter to increase throughput and excel at this year’s game. High quality fueling ensures the lights never go off.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team was eager to apply advanced simulation to their controller design. They implemented a broad data collection of their game play, feeding it back to refine their detailed simulation models to improve controller performance post game play. Their solution iterated and gnawed away their errors improving their overall robot control.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.script: These competitors have unleashed autonomy on the competition. Their robot is a true champion of perception and control. In the race to build a machine that sees contours as well as adapting and reacting at breakneck speeds, this team makes other teams green with envy.

records.eventName: ONT District University of Waterloo Event
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team’s energy matches the striking appearance of the team and the robot They have built a fearless identity and always celebrate winning in style. These little devils are not easily intimidated.

This team has everything covered. They focus on sharing technology, hold inclusive conference meetings, have an awesome robot design, and also introduced a new-parts trading system. This team makes their impact and professionalism as simple as a walk in the PARK.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Every team wants to shoot for the stars. And this team inspires engineering across the galaxy. They spread their message into the universe, but start close at home with their planet-and-moon orbiting system.

After an early setback, this team regrouped, refocused, and rebuilt. Staying true to the spirit of the award and the K.I.S.S. principle, they kept the redesign clean, simple, and smart. Powered by their rebuilt feature -- a seriously impressive fuel throughput -- this heavyweight rolled into the competition ready to prove their THEORY.
This team's spirit, teamwork, and FUSION impressed. The Judges were wowed by their UNIFIED strength. From the depths of challenging waters, these ALLOYS merged to unleash the Kraken.

This team has rebuilt from the rubble of others. With big plans for next year, their goal is to come out of Niagara strengthened. In their rookie season, this team has remained CALM in the face of a MOUNTain of work, and engineered a miracle on a budget.

From the ashes of uncertainty, this team refused to stay down, choosing instead to rise with relentless determination. Self-taught and unstoppable, they climbed financial towers, sparked a community, and brought STEM to life at every opportunity. Driven by grit, heart, and a "we will make this happen" mindset, this team is roaring with purpose and the embodiment of resilience in motion.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This wise group have really helped bring other teams into the world of robotics. Sustainability is at the heart of everything they do, and they take that responsibility very seriously by offsetting their carbon footprint and raising funds for other teams as well as themselves. While they also write children's books, these busy bees been writing their own feel-good story.

This award goes to a team that is keeping the energy up in their pit and on the bleachers. From a galaxy far away, this team is staying alive by using their team spirit to raise funds and engage their community. Ain't GNOMEbody except them got the stamina to dance for the crowd all weekend long.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: From concept to completion, this team proves that even small beginnings can lead to beautifully engineered solutions. Through intentional design choices, they evolved an early proof of concept into a refined machine supported by a well-documented engineering process, creating a system where every component works in harmony. These innovators took inspiration from a little robot with big ideas, bringing curiosity and creativity to the field.

This team could always be found around the pits helping someone else. They support other teams with coopertition and GOVERN themselves using the principles of FIRST. Being gracious take a deep commitment, but to this team it seems SIM-ple.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Some teams make very creative use of recycled parts, and these innovators clamped down on the competition with a clever twist of design. They really dug deep by transforming an everyday component into a purposeful feature to lift themselves up. Embodying imperfection and simplicity in both name and design, this robot’s creativity effortlessly hooks your attention.

After suffering early damage that could have ended their competition, this team didn't panic; they relied on their excellent quality framework. They executed rigourous quality checks to identify the problem and solution, and rebuild even better. With an innovative 3D-printed shooter bearing, their bot Leo pounced on the competition.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team brings a majestic approach to a central, circular shooting turret as an innovative system. Their integration of control and mechanical systems uses a magnificent curved arm to smoothly guide the fuel to the shooter. In a court of jokers and jesters, this sovereign monarch makes it rain fuel over all their subjects.

During the autonomous mode, shooting and moving around a lot are very useful features. This team makes us green with envy by using a large-span turret and a shoot-from-anywhere approach. Here, shooting is always in auto, and this team encodes their limelight to bring their green to anywhere on the field.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team's image is bright, colourful, and creatively represents their values and culture. Evoking their home, the imagery connects the team's past to their future, and helps bring the arts to STEM. The winning team will rocket, snowshoe, or jingle-dance down to the field to receive this award.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.script: This powerhouse team has shattered systemic glass ceilings, proving that neither language nor socio-economic status should ever be a barrier to innovation These students are tickled pink to show the world what they can achieve.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team brings their love of STEM to their school and community, through interactive games that test their reflexes. They live the belief that science is for everyone. Their commitment to creating lasting impact in their community is truly wired in, and they certainly have nine lives left!

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.script: This blue beauty is so cool, it’s hot. This robot represents the gold standard of fabrication and elegant engineering. As a result of their efforts, this team didn’t just build a machine, they engineered a masterpiece, worth its weight in gold.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.script: This team sets a powerful example by stipulating that every decision belongs to the students on the team. By taking ownership of their work, they demonstrate that true leadership means that coaches and leaders step back so the team can step up. The judges award for self-determination goes to…

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.script: This rookie team started strong, using a defensive strategy to ensure their success. Despite their small roster, they actively supported other teams when needed, and benefitted from reciprocal support. Their passion for FIRST, combined with extensive teamwork, BUMPED their robot through the qualifying rounds.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.script: This team has had some ups and downs recently. But like currents in the ocean, they kept pushing forward, drawing strength from their community, to create a real TIDAL wave.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Rising from the ashes, this team has rebuilt and rebranded by recruiting members from throughout their community. Fulfilling the mission to recycle, reuse, and repurpose, this team’s robot is built almost entirely from used components and discarded parts. Mischief managed. Dumbledore would be proud.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.script: These competitors are hard to HOLD ONTO. This team has a rhythm of its own, with slow CLAPS of thunder being heard from far away. With their infectious positivity and team pride, nothing is LOST on this team.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team’s robot was true lightning in a bottle. They built a robust and reliable robot with gathering and shooting capabilities on par with some of the best robots. Their magnetism truly sets their robot apart and helps them stomp their way to the top.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.script: This team takes out reach to a whole new GLOBAL level, Driven by a passion to share their knowledge and SPARK, they were constant figures of support, making a lasting impact on other teams wherever they were found. Their constant presence and supportive nature allowed them to have a significant, positive, and COLOURFUL impact on others.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: A robust full court view is the name of the game. A creative rethink was required to ensure good reliable connections. At the end of the day, this team believes creativity isn’t just about making something new. It’s about seeing an old problem through a new lens.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.script: With a clean machine, clearly built to last, this team has a great plan. By digitizing their team’s institutional knowledge, they bring new members up to speed with a quick scan. They’ve learned from the past, from a team of raiders - where quality stands fast.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Down the highway to Windsor they came to set the field on fire like their namesake. We’re all glad this team from the Forest City kept the heat on the field. To perfect their control they built a digital twin to train younger team members and lock in their win.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.script: This team flies to success as they battle in the DANGER ZONE. Their robot is a true multi-role fighter, to be deployed in any position on the field, gathering, scoring, and climbing autonomously. With their wingmen, they are the top gun.

records.eventName: ONT District Windsor Essex Great Lake Event
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Nothing could tame this team’s ability to attract sponsors, with a custom designed website, and a BOT to do the rest. Their digital presence could only be out-done by their in-person fierceness. The crowd will go WILD when this team takes the field!

Even when training dragons, this team stands united. With a mission as their compass, they choose impact over excess— focusing every effort on inclusion and meaningful change. From meeting challenges head-on to creating greater accessibility in their community, they turn purpose into action—Go Baby Go!

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team is setting the bar sky high. Making the most of what they have, this team is a beacon of STEM for students in their district. These birds have spread their wings and we can’t wait to see where their feathers (and tiaras) go!

This team knows exactly “WATT” they are doing. Thanks to their sleek design and elegant manufacturing, it’s no surprise to see their glowing victories. This robot’s design electrified the field and zapped competition.

records.teamName: SWARM - South and West Albany Robotics Maniacs
records.script: This team’s documentation flies above the rest. The hum of their printers could be heard buzzing along all weekend. Their swarm really comes together in the hive to ensure a quality robot.
In tough times, they roll together and they don't let anything slow them down. Floating above their challenges, they're flying toward new heights.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This magical team inspires awe and wonder. They demonstrated initiative and entrepreneurship by deciphering how to turn a sweet budgeting idea into an ongoing revenue source. They are a team loaded with big flavor like a batch of homemade cookies.

The dinosaurs may be extinct, but this team’s enthusiasm for robotics is just getting started. The students may be new to the program, but they already know that there’s more to robot design than copying and pasting.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team slips under the trench. With a robot that has compact packaging to avoid jams, the design process allows them to deviate from the Mean.
Don’t look for blue skies because it is starting to get cloudy! This team works hard in the off season to make sure all teams succeed. They’re always there to help during a storm!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team more than chatters from the branches of trees. Their two sided approach to gathering acorns has drawn the judges praises. Celebrate with us a unique and creative design to harvest fuel from the robotics field.

This team’s robot was designed from the ground up with reliability in mind. With robust engineering and smart decision making, they don’t leave emptying their hopper to chance. Each time they go over the bump to fill their hopper, they came back with a pot of gold.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team’s controls really resonate with the judges. Their polar automation system, and inventive redirection really threw a wrench in their opponents plans. This team sees tech and innovates.

For them, G.O.A.T. stands for Greatest of Autonomous Teams Their homemade physics engine and ability to shoot on the move have them balling out like The King The dinosaurs may be extinct, but this team’s expertise in autonomous is just getting started Yes, that line was copied and pasted

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: With a theme that sails above the rest. From the top of their heads to their unique nautical nicknames. This team’s pit is a treasure trove of history and booty.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.script: Boldly going where few teams go, their members span boundaries of time and state to grow a community robotics program — one brick at a time. Sure, their top fundraiser is a little spooky — but their STEM camps and Palouse-wide reach are sprouting opportunities that are downright inspiring their rural community. As a result the small burgs of Pullman and Moscow have a FIRST machine called the Sciborgs.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Like ripples across the sand this team leaves their mark on their community and beyond. By uncovering innovative ways to build up teams and advocating for STEM from the West coast to the East coast, they are building bridges for the future of youth across the country. This teams effort is no longer……off the record.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.script: With thoughtful strategy and calculated precision, this team creates solutions where every part has a purpose. Their ability to organize complexity, streamline processes, and turn many moving pieces into one efficient system demonstrating a deep understanding of industrial engineering. And when one small idea creates a ripple that improves the entire robot........... you might say this team understands the butterfly effect.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.script: ** Title of award sung like "Bob the Builder..."** The Jim the Builder Award This technical team laid a foundation for future success. They've spotted a place for school improvement and pounced. Creating a space for practice fields, shop tools, and maintenance.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.script: When your school sits smack on the Oregon Trail and 'Pioneer' is practically your middle name, you don't just face challenges — you BYTE right through them! This Sandy squad found their way with the help of an innovatively designed hub tracker to guide their team and proved that the Gateway to Mount Hood is also the gateway to greatness. Saddle up, because this all star just arrived in style!

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.script: When almost half of your team consists of rookies, training can be a challenge. Showing patience, kindness, and effective leadership DURING training while STILL LEARNING yourselves is even more impressive. This team ironed out any wrinkle and flocked together.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team is building their future with their recycling program. They are igniting their community through STEM nights and summer FLL camps. When it comes to sustainability this team is leaving a trail of sparks.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.script: All are welcome to join this COMPANY and find a home. Flexible schedules allow the team to support their students both in the district and out. Their enthusiasm hits true as they *AIM* for the sky.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: One essential part of engineering is taking calculated risks, such as a new robot subsystem. With mountains of documentation and a clear, safe, and effective training program, this team demonstrated that their engineering knowledge extended beyond the field. Don't get caught in the smolder, because this robot rocks.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.script: This team showers their knowledge and experience across all levels of FIRST, covering areas near and far. Their culture matrix creates a balanced and welcoming climate within their team and shines on the teams they support. They bring families and teams together under their umbrella to uplift and empower, turning potential storms into sunshine.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team designed their robot around passing and high throughput. Their strategy paid off as their **HOT** robot dominated the field. Terrific creativity with their hopper-less design.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.script: Through determination and creativity, this team turned big ideas into reliable well-built solutions. Their robot roared onto the field with precision, reliability, and attention to detail that made it clear their quality wasn't accidental, it was engineered from the start. And when you watch the students driving their robot, with TWICE the focus and TWICE the grit, you knew they were DETERMINED to built it.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team's robot tracked game pieces with impressive accuracy and navigated the field with smooth, reliable precision. When this teams runs into challenges, they **HATCH** it out to remain successful under the pressure of game play. The judges could SEE the strength of their control system right away.......and some might even wish they could **COPY** their design.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.script: This team uses encoders and vision tracking to constantly determine turret position and location on the field. They are able to move with *blazing* precision before even touching the controls. With other robots scrambled, this team kept their cool in the coop.

records.eventName: PNW District Oregon State Fair Event
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Their flag flies across the pit. They have been swimming in a sea of fuel and climbing the masts. Some may call it the Ship of Theseus.
Many teams went into rebuild mode post-COVID. This team rebuilt their team, changed their school culture, and became “Super Hosts,” all in the last 3 years.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Their outreach FLOWS across borders, helping others access tools, opportunity, and inspiration. And with a strong culture of mentorship that ensures rookies are guided by veterans, they ensure a CURRENT of knowledge for seasons to come. With their MONSTER programs that run deep and rises all tides...

records.teamName: SWARM - South and West Albany Robotics Maniacs
records.script: This team’s pit was always a-BUZZ with activity. When talking about their level of documentation, the judges thought they were POLLEN our leg. But after seeing their bot and their binder, this decision was easy-“BEE”-zy.

This team truly BEARS their passion for making a difference. Through creativity, humor, and education, they’ve turned a meme into a mission – helping others learn why protecting our oceans and the animals that call them home truly matters. So when you see a team that’s un-bear-ably enthusiastic, with a robot inspired by the ocean’s most lovable sea potato, you’ve probably found SNORB, SNORB, SNORB.
This team’s growth is funded by removing financial barriers to participate. This investment in their future will NET a positive return. They are rebuilding a strong base to reach SKYward.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: It takes a FLOCK committed to building programs that SOAR year after year. Through clever resourcefulness, strong community partnerships, and programs that keep their impact FLYING long after the season. Let’s hear it for the team that keeps their programs SOARING and whose sustainability efforts are truly SEAGULL-AR.

Some bring cheers, but this team makes a SPLASH you can feel, sending WAVES of energy and excitement through the entire competition. Their enthusiasm keeps the event swimming with laughter, positivity, and a true celebration of the FIRST core values, no matter the score. When the arena brightens, the cheers flash electric blue, and the energy surges like a beta fish on the charge, you’ll know who is making waves...

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: These competitors have “lit” up the field with their flawless engineering. Their robot delivers fuel to stoke the “flames” of their alliance. When excellence is the standard, they “fly” above the bar, never singeing their “feathers.”
Marching across the field, this team is winning the battle by connecting with teams across the Northwest, making friends one sticker at a time.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Their efforts may be endless but they are far from futile. With their dizzying rotor, turret, and serpentine belt spinning, this mischievous machine is to “dye” for.
This team clearly has pride in their bot. Their thorough knowledge of subsystems speaks volumes of these engineers-to-be. The quality of their construction caused a roar in the judges room.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Even though green means go, this team is red hot on the field. Assisted driving allows this team to make shots in the dark while setting the field ablaze.
As soon as the match starts, this team is seeing RED. Their consistent auto is a perfect COPY, match after match. This team’s precise pathfinding leaves XERO room for MISTAKES.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Finding attractiveness and outstanding visual aesthetic integration was no walk in the park. This team sifted through the rubble to uncover their strong branding and bring it to life. IT’S ALIVE!

This team prioritized transformation over multiple seasons, not just one year. They don’t take no for an answer, even when that no comes from a state legislature. They built their pipeline so students have an opportunity to experience FIRST in every grade. Clever names and even more clever programs make this team stand out.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team is engaged in summer camps, STEM nights, and community support. They’ve worked with their school to keep “AI” on a short leash. It’s no wonder why this team makes sure that everyone in their community has a DAWG in the fight.
This team displayed high ideals with a sleek aesthetic. They “red” the rules to design an elegant robot that that met the game’s needs. They will now fly like an eagle and carry this award home

After the season ends, this team collectively comes together to learn and improve. Their initiatives to excite the next generation include programs for Special Education students. The judges have been charged up with accessible ride-on toy cars and Unified Robotics.

This team experienced many challenges that left them unsure if they would make it to the field. Embracing peer-to-peer collaboration and positive attitude, they turned every obstacle into opportunity. Their resilience and determination will ensure the team is destined to climb any ridge.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team continues to add teams to their pipeline through multiple FIRST programs. They don’t just add teams and leave; their team members are mentoring the younger students. Inclusivity is part of their plan to sustain as they fly forward with autism and sensory bags.

With a smile on their face and a can-do attitude, this team rose up to face any challenge. They are always able to see the forest for the trees. This team won’t let themselves be deer in the headlights.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: From kickoff to competition, this team came up with an engineering solution that collected and scored all the gold rings. Their robot’s sleek design allows for easy serviceability and success. You can feel the wind between the brushes as they zoom across the field.

This team embraces the principles of gracious professionalism. They bring good vibes and energy no matter what happens. The judges were impressed by their DEMON-er (demeanor) both on and off the field.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Turning history into inspiration, this team used a unique element to store fuel. Just as NASA trusted the fabric to bring astronauts home, this team relied on the Apollo 11 parachute material to carry its design.

Sleek and elegant; colorful and pristine: this bold team’s machine is a dream. Baking parts and proving their smarts, this robot stole the judge’s hearts. A well-built machine that can shoot a barrage, this team cannot be sa-BOT-aged.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team’s control systems are out of this world. Their zonal controls allow the robot to know exactly where it is on the field at all times. They’ve vivi-fied the competition with their accuracy. Robot ready. Driver ready. Shoot.

Using machine learning, this team can detect fuel reliably on the field. Eating fuel like a hungry hungry hippo, this team did not let the bump stop them from coming back for seconds. Their auto is out of this world.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team has dug up some gold to fuel their adventure. They are honoring their history with their old-timey uniform design. There’s no monkeying around when celebrating their past.

Through an unwavering commitment to FIRST core values, this team has been instrumental securing sponsorships, rebuilding teams, developing curriculum and increasing diversity in their programs. Forging meaningful connections through outreach and the media, they promote FIRST in their schools and with local government. They have stayed ‘true north’ in their mission to revitalize a region to sustain and grow FIRST.

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team impressed the judges with their unique and numerous STEM outreach. They dug deep and made these activities more accessible. This team deserves a THUNDERIOUS round of applause.

This team formed an impressive cadre of engineers. Their extensive modularity allowed them to create numerous designs. By watching their tolerances with EAGLE EYES, they were able to seamlessly bring their subsystems into FORMATION.

When this team recognized an issue occurring at a local wildlife area due to government cuts, they reached out and lent their engineering skills to repair a retaining wall and protect trails. Their efforts will allow public access for years to come. The judges award for building walls for a cause goes to TEAM 7515

These friendly students built a robot like a piece of CAKE. These competitors inspired new TRENDS throughout their city. This team's social media and GRAFFITI engaged new members and grew their community.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team runs a sustainable FIRST pipeline by mentoring FLL & FTC teams. They create a personal impact on all students, through mentorship groups and teaching abroad with low cost materials. Their hard work maintaining their team and the Steel City Robotics Alliance showed through in their riveting presentation.
This team exudes high voltage enthusiasm. They can be found thundering down the halls in a champion-SHIP high school. You will want to be struck by their Lightning Bots!

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: These young engineers have kindled a spirit of professionalism. Design integration issues withered under their scrutiny and holistic review. Together they IGNITED their passion for robotics.

When other teams are in need of help this teams answers the call. Their commitment of getting EVERY team onto the playing field was out of this world. Even in the heat of battle their team's table ensures "No Robot is Left Behind".

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team identified their top problem to manage. Learning from their past, and disassembling their workshop helped them prototype and explore ideas. After several prototypes, and trips to Home Depot, they built a support system to help their turret SPRING into action.
This team shows quality. From their intake to the shooter, from their code to their processes, this team rarely misses. They're sharpshooters, with both wires and fuel rarely out of place.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team powers their own curiosity. No obstacle went undetected, no robot command uninformed. Only they can FUSE the atomic ones and zeros of competition.

Auto starts, this robot takes off, leaps into the neutral zone, then runs back and lands dozens of shots. Automatically, they do it again. This team shows that autonomous can be on par with teleop points.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team ran with its theme, starting with its history and continuing through the Robot. They dug deep into the theme's origin to fit it into their name, their robot and their pit. We are so lucky that they chose to honor us here in Pittsburgh with Irish, Green and Leprechauns.

This team has maintained a long history of involvement in the FIRST community. They have continued to expand their reach and impact in both their own community and abroad. Among their new initiatives is a team sponsored college scholarship. They are literally on FIRE!

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: Promoting STEM from an early age is key to effective growth. Additional training enhances team member experience and develops core competency. These and many other initiatives allows this team to sprout and flower
This teams robot has a streamlined design that effectively sweeps up fuel. They use multiple cameras to accurately launch fuel cells into the hub like a lancer
This team utilized what resources they had, nothing was spared form the recycle pile. In every sense of the word, this team was REBUILT!

This team is starting with a clear documentation plan that includes community outreach. They have a clear drive to enhance STEM in their community. They are not just shooting for the fairway, they are aiming for the green
This team has perservered through the growing pains and continue to climb higher atop the mountain

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team impressed the judges with their approach to team development and growth. Your opinion won’t be soured when you hear about their solid funding base and Lego focused outreach.
This team impressed the judges with their enthusiasm and positivity. Their road to success included making lots of friends and having fun!

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team impressed the judges with their well designed and assembled robot. These CATS clawed their way to the top with their vision processing, turret shooter and functional LED’s

Despite multiple setbacks this team represents FIRST values through their laughter, positivity and interactions with other teams. They certainly bring extra weight to the words Gracious Professionalism.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team exemplifies creativity by flipping their perspective and their robot. Uncovering artifacts as it moves from Oklahoma to Nevada.
This team utilized precision machining and 3D printing to create a lightweight and robust robot. Their entire robot from wiring to bumpers and components is easy to service

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Whether it is systems designed to cross the bump or shoot , this team proved that good things come to those that wait and put in the work. While not FLEET the judges got the message
Surveying the field this team was looking to score regardless of the zone. Their robot moved with precision whether passing or shooting and was LOCKED on

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team impressed the judges with their consistent branding around this year’s theme. Their updated logo explored past game seasons and was built into their pit, uniforms and robot

This Team’s outreach is tailored to their audience From LEGOS to supporting rookies, they are intentional in every initiative they support. Their ability to see the light in every individual helps each person shine.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team came together to educate their community, never straying on their quest to discover core values. It only takes a few stars to make a constellation of inspiring engineers.
Their comprehensive design fills their hopper to the brim. The teams’ robot was a sturdy pillar in the competition. The judges tip their hats to the clean design and electrical wiring.

For this tight-knit team, communication is key. Inclusivity is the priority for both programming and speaking The judges award for breaking language boundaries is proudly awarded to Team 1811, team Fresh.

From raiding the basement for parts, to fostering an FLL pipeline, these rookies are building more than just a robot – they’re building a culture. They may have started with a FrankenBot, but they’re anything but just disjointed. With a foundation as strong as Blue Steel, we can’t wait to see how high these dragons fly.
This team has created a foundation for success, seeking to launch STEM in their community and internationally. Watch out! This team is about to BLAST off!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team rode down i-95 on a new quest for success, recruiting squires from movie nights, school workshops, FTC, FLL and parading the robot through their town. Their strong succession planning, management of their treasury and reuse of their robot parts prepares them to duel new challenges and power their honored future.

This team keeps an eye on what truly matters by turning every competition into a moment of connection. They bring. Out those around them by discovering their attributes and also transforming what’s left behind into something worth keeping. They put their spirit and all the cards on the table.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This used clever use of simulation to eliminate many real world faults before physical construction began. They demonstrated mastery over the engineering process to seamlessly marry their software and hardware. I bet they can move and shoot even during an earthquake.

This team charges full TILT into Gracious Professionalism SPEARheading initiatives at schools throughout the area. Bringing the CAVALRY to teams and events for FLL, FTC and now their first FRC event. The award for Gracious Professionalism goes to team 321, the Robolancers.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Creativity and ambition were incorporated into this robot intentionally. Functional color coordination and 3D prints were instrumental in their design. Their double shooting is quite the anomaly.
This team has it covered, literally. Their lifted turret fits a neat path for wiring, and they are prepared with a stockpile of spare parts. This team is rolling out of the hills, ready to go!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team smartly utilized driver controls so their robot doesn’t go berserk. Real time communication with the field assists match strategy, leading to impressive results. It is no miracle why this team gets their robot to work.

This team carves through the neutral zone, scooping up fuel. Their hard rests account for discrepancies between vision and odometry, and the ramp is no barrier to their routines. If you see a black and red storm coming, hide your fuel!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This teams imagery really struck a chord with the judges. They’ve successfully channeled who they are as a people into a brand that is as professional In the classroom as it is in the pits,. To be Frank their aesthetic is a bonafide “symphony of destruction” that show they are “breaking the law” of boring design

This team ensures each of their initiatives aligns with their community's needs. They balance longstanding programs with new initiatives as their community grows alongside them. From STEM Sprouts to Sparky to Ramp Riot seminars, they don't just build robots - they build people.

records.awardName: District Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This team worked hard to spread STEM while rebuilding themselves since COVID. Their outreach has turned outside-in as organizations within their neighborhood contact them about demos, seminars, and classes. They have truly rooted themselves throughout the community with FORCE.
With elegant, efficient and extensive prototyping they developed a competitive robot. Their IZZY can make you DIZZY but they found the Holy Grail with their design.
This rookie team came to FRC looking for a bigger challenge. They're doing more with less by investing in their future. We hope to see these Ferrite Craniums next year as well.

This rookie team has already crossed borders- building a powerful community presence locally and abroad while leading with true student-driven passion. With a standout engineering notebook, strong program management and a digital voice that's fueling momentum and ready for liftoff!

The Rising All Star Award celebrates the team that has persisted through challenges, despite the difficulties of being young. This could be the result of being a new team, or a team with recent turnover in membership. This team finished building their robot just in time for their first competition. Their team tripled in size since last year as they build for the future. These spooky kids are role models for good communication. Way to go Team 10070!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Their apprentices look up to the masters Their subleads look up to their leads Their summer camp feeds the future member pipeline and helps pay the bills... Happy 30th anniversary team 75

These Hatchlings were breathing fire into every challenge and spoke with a candid passion that scorched. Their unwavering dedication and collective roar proved that no obstacle could dim their team spirit. Sharpen your steel dragon trainers, for the blue steel dragons unite!

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: This team has a clean, thoughtful, unique design that took market research, strategy, lessons learned and manufacturing principles into consideration. Their pillar assembly is functional, innovative and contributes to their success. You could say they have a 'killer' spin cycle! Let's all tip our caps to the HATTERS for their excellence in Engineering

In a competition driven by innovation, intensity and ambition, it is commendable for a team to lend a helping hand. This team, in the true spirit of FIRST, be it in the pits or on the field, has supported other teams without hesitation. Whenever a team needed help, their horse galloped to the rescue.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team's robot showcases a strategy where every mechanism serves more that one purpose - maximizing performance and design. They reimagined what their robot could be with the materials they had available. In a field of competition, their purple stands out- and so does this team with cutting edge creativity.
This team enjoys being stuck in the past. But their process led them to a high quality design. A clean sweep combined with an excellent game strategy provided a platform for a future artifact.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Throughout this competition, this crew constantly came up with innovative and practical controls. They rode a WAVE of duct tape and dreams, coming up with good quick changes in the pits to increase their fuel capacity and be a huge contender. Lets give it up to this team that has 'slap shot' their way to the top of the competition.

This team has demonstrated consistent, reliable and highly autonomous robot. They not only showed extreme accuracy and modularity during the autonomous period of the match, bur FRIED the competition during tele-op with their automatic aiming. This team won by learning, give it up for team 1168 Malvern Robotics!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Black and Brown and red their colors, Stetsons upon their heads they wear, Their look is sharp and strong. Where there is a 'Will' there is a way.

Leading with passion, this team REVEALED a portfolio full of causes for amending STEM to include everyone. They served as INFORMANTS to the state board of education, escorting them into their shop to BRIEF them on the impact of FIRST. From credits with Arizona State University, to sponsored manufacturing for Uplift Challenge teams, this team makes succeeding from a small town anything but a [shh!] SECRET.

From running camps, to hosting events, this team approaches every mission with planning and LOGIC. Through the sweetness of upcakes, they FORM ALLIANCES with students of under-represented genders. They have even built a sustainable outreach program, BOLDLY GOING to Cairo and Sudan, leaving the Judges knowing that for this team, there is no FINAL FRONTIER.

records.awardName: District Championship Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: This bright team inspired the judges with their commitment to STEM education, support for FIRST programs, and out-of-this-world outreach efforts. Bringing STEM to students who don't have access, they launched 7 FLL teams and 2 FTC teams in the past year, are currently mission control for 14 FLL and 4 FTC teams, and were ground zero for two FLL qualifiers, two FTC league meets, and one FTC league tournament this season. Their astronomical efforts even included teaching FLL to Ninjas.

records.awardName: District Championship Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: With more than 60 programs and thousands of STEAM kits distributed, this team’s inspiration spreads like ripples in a pond. From passing funding measures and promoting STEM education, to starting new FIRST teams at home and abroad, they even work with hospitals and law enforcement to spread the values of FIRST. Need a night out to feel the music? Suit up and call these monsters, STAT!

Creating mayhem on and off the field, this team had the judges stunned with feature, after feature, after feature…After feature. Their robot definitely doesn’t rely on luck for its success. They innovated by pioneering new composites, laminating polycarbonate and spring steel to improve collector reliability. They even created new ceramic coatings in close partnership with their sponsor, that can be seen on their turret…and bumper mounts?...and robot handles??? This team is turning THEORY into practice, bringing order to the CHAOS.

They spread the spirit of STEM, both locally and internationally. They are helping to improve access to science experiments to impoverished communities with affordable STEM Unbox Kits. They build the pieces and parts, and are now getting ready to send them packing.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: What’s the difference between a floppy disc and a hard drive? One is flexible, and the other one breaks. This flexible team overcame unknown glitches. They gathered supports in BYTE-sizes. They created a TEAM HUB to encourage communication and track electronic tasks.

An age old problem: need more funds, and more team members. They are a role model to follow, tripling their membership and outreaching to others. They have a lot of solutions in their quiver, and will shoot their arrows on target.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team knows that building a sustainable program means investing in people, resources, and the future. They visit middle schools for early recruitment, put on Car Washes for Krakens, and recycle cans for extra cash. They built their robot with second-hand parts from sponsors to reuse material. This connection with industry is truly legendary.

This vibrant team stands out in a crowd. They hold summer workshops; their team is open to all interests and skill levels; and they are abundant at community events. They come together across many open spaces and age levels. Supported across generations, the THRIFTY GRANDMOTHERS will be so proud.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: Pushing engineering to its limits, this team demonstrated the merits of professional process. Barreling down the field in black, this robot has been tested through many iterations. With efficient repairs and industry standard powder coating, there’s nothing BARE about this METAL.

This team shares their practice space with many. Their generosity doesn’t stop there: they offer free workshops and shared curricula. Many teams’ senses are a little safer; in fact, you can SMELL the Safety.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: With a twist of the wrist, this team ROSE above the rest. Utilizing 5-Axis CNC machining and a 700-to-1 gear ratio, they climb HIGHER than the sun. This team proves that these ARE the droids you are looking for.

This green team’s robot unassumingly navigates the field. They prioritized reliability and efficiency in their robot through its modular design, providing the opportunity for quick swaps of all of its components. You can say OSIRIS doesn’t need a four-leaf CLOVER to be lucky.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: From east of Seattle, precise and intense, This team leaves nothing at all to chance. More than a robot, take one good glance… This system doesn’t just move, it thinks in advance. Four cameras audit each move they make, While LIDAR ensures there’s no margin for mistake. They simulate first, before parts ever click, Because guessing is risky… and audits are quick. Control here isn’t filed as trial and error, It’s engineered clean, no bugs, no terror. So when it comes down to details, near or far, This team knows how to ACCOUNT for who they are.

From north of Seattle, bold and supreme, Comes a robot that rules like a well-oiled dream. With cameras that track every inch of the field, No target escapes, no secret concealed. It climbs to the throne while it scores on the way, A Queen in control… come what may. The hood shifts mid-flight, no need to pause, Each shot lands clean, to thunderous applause. Through hits and through hustle, it never backs down, Because this machine was built to wear the crown.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.teamName: SWARM - South and West Albany Robotics Maniacs
records.script: This team’s flight has them hovering above the rest. With integration of team, pit, and robot, they have been DRILLING down to the smallest of details, earning their stripes. “Yellow-black, yellow-black, yellow-black.” Oh! Black and yellow! Yeah! Let’s shake it up a little.

Cette équipe a commencé par bâtir une culture d’inclusion véritable… un endroit où chaque élève se sentait accueilli, valorisé et encouragé à prendre sa place comme leader. À partir de cette base, leur rayonnement s’est étendu — d’abord dans leur école… puis dans leur quartier… jusqu’à devenir un programme communautaire en STIM qui ouvre maintenant des portes là où il n’y en avait aucune. Ils prouvent que la persévérance et la créativité peuvent transformer toute une communauté, avec le cœur de vrais Spartiates,

records.awardName: Regional Engineering Inspiration Award sponsored by SpaceX
records.script: The scale and effectiveness of the efforts deployed demonstrate exceptional inventiveness. Their broad involvement in STEM and regional engagement have led to the adoption of laws to promote FIRST objectives in their flamboyant festival country. Get ready to dance SAMBA!

Prêt à se plier en deux pour se hisser tout en haut, ce robot est difficile à déloger, dans tous les sens du terme! Conçu pour se mouvoir partout sur le terrain, lancer de façon efficace et grimper de façon renversante, ce robot bénéficie d’un design optimisé qui lui permet de performer sur le terrain.

Malgré des défis de financement, cette équipe a persévéré et prouvé que la robotique mérite sa place dans leur école. Leur rayonnement international a convaincu leur école, leurs commanditaires, et apparemment aussi les juges, dont ils collectionnent les selfies avec une efficacité redoutable. Par leur persévérance et leur prise en main, ils ont prouvé qu’on n’arrête pas facilement une ruche qui bourdonne.

Cette équipe a su redéployer ses ailes pour mieux se reconstruire. Ils ont recréé une structure d'équipe robuste et inspirante, tout en assurant la pérennité de leurs actions. Un accomplissement réussi PAR les jeunes FLL et POUR revivre FRC.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Cette équipe renouvelée démontre une solide cohésion et une organisation hors pair. Leur présence sur les médias sociaux est telle qu’il est possible de suivre leur progrès même à l’hôpital. Leurs gestions d’équipe et financières définissent un nouveau STAN-dard.

Les juges ont reconnu toutes les activités que cette équipe a accomplies tout au long de l'année. Vous pouvez les voir convaincre de nouvelles recrues tout en les aidant à faire leurs devoirs. Vous pouvez les croiser dans les écoles primaires alors qu'ils présentent leur robot, les buffets du samedi qu'ils organisent, ou même au travail chez leur partenaire. Qui sait, c'est peut-être le café qui leur donne autant d'énergie ! Vous devez tourner la tête dans tous les sens comme une chouette pour suivre tout ce qu'ils font.

records.awardName: Excellence in Engineering Award sponsored by Littelfuse
records.script: Leur processus de conception nickel nous a impressionnés autant au puits que sur le terrain. Leur gestion de projet à l'aide d'un chronogramme leur a permis d'accomplir tous les aspects du défi. Ils doivent manger des Spécial "K" au déjeuner pour présenter de façon si impeccable avec un "K".

Cette équipe a parcouru beaucoup de kilomètres pour incarner l’esprit de collaboration qui est au cœur des valeurs de FIRST. Ils inspirent par leur professionnalisme, leur détermination et leur passion à aider non seulement des équipes de leur région, mais également des jeunes hors de leurs frontières. Cette semaine, ils ont traversé l’Atlantique pour accomplir leur mission de Faire Connaître, Faire Aimer, et Agir.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Cette équipe a une vision créative des robots de nouvelle génération et, comme le USS Enterprise, a pris les risques pour explorer des frontières technologiques inconnues. Conception et design élégant facile d’entretien, technologie de Formule 1, apprentissage machine et mode autonome évolués embarqué. C’est le retour DYNAMIQUE des Jetson’s qui ont su intégrer l’intelligence artificielle.

Some machines are built to perform. Others are built to carry the load. With a robot that shows exceptional build quality, precision in every detail, and the strength to perform consistently under pressure, this team has set the standard for reliability.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Chaque année, leur robot nous impressionne. La mouture 2026 demande de gérer 16 moteurs, la pneumatique, 4 caméras ayant chacune leur “Orange Pi” et une tourelle avec un rouleau additionnel pour limiter l’effet rétro. Sa conception a demandé beaucoup de café et de contrôle pour faire fonctionner tout cela et atteindre la cible en mouvement.

Ce titan père du Dieu Soleil nous a éblouis. Polyvalent, constant et adaptatif, ce robot s’est clairement démarqué dans ses opérations autonomes. Il a embrasé le terrain tel un joueur HYPER-performant.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
